chapters.title: A chapter on the discussion of Christians regarding the use of the word essence to God Almighty
paragraphs: [Chapter: Discussion with the Christians regarding applying the term “essence” to God Almighty]
Chapter: The narrator said about them: So I said, “They disapprove of our saying:

Indeed, God - the Almighty - is an essence. They said, “We hear about these people that they are possessors of virtue, etiquette, and knowledge, and from this is His form.” He read something from the books of philosophers and logicians, so what right do they have to deny this to us? This is because there is nothing in existence that is not either an essence or an essence. Or an accident; Because whatever matter we look at, we find that it either exists on its own and does not lack anything else in its existence, which is the essence, or it lacks something else in its existence. His existence to something other than Him has no substance in itself, and He is the accident, and it is not possible for these two parts to have a third part.
The most noble of these two parts is the one that exists by itself and does not lack anything else in its existence. It is the essence.

And since the Creator - may His names be sanctified - was the most honorable of all beings; Since He is the cause of everything else, He necessitated that it be the most honorable and the highest in substance. That is why we say that it is a substance, not like created substances. Just as we say that it is a thing, not like created things, otherwise it would have to be He is sustained by something else and lacks in his existence other than Him, and this is an abomination for what can be said about God - the Almighty - so I said to them that they say, “Indeed” We refrain from calling it an essence; Because essence does not accept accident and does not occupy space, and for this reason it is called the saying that it - the Almighty - is essence.

They said: The one that accepts an accident and occupies a space is the dense substance. As for the subtle substance, it is the one that accepts an accident and does not occupy a space. Such as the essence of the soul, the essence of the mind, the essence of light, and the other gentle created essences that flow through this stream.

If the created subtle gems do not accept an accident and do not occupy space, then the Creator of the subtle and dense gems, And the compound of the substances with the densities accepts a width and occupies a space? both.

The answer is in a number of ways: one of them is to say: As for calling the Creator a substance. It is one of the least objectionable things to Christians. For this reason, there were some people who denied it from the point of view of law - only - or language, and among them were those who denied it from the point of view of reason as well, and among them were those who He sees it as a verbal dispute. A group of Muslims call it substance and body as well. This is because Muslims talk about the names of God Almighty in two ways, and many of them say:
Its auditory names are legal, so it is not called except by the names that the Sharia brought, for this is an act of worship, and acts of worship are based on Stop and follow.
Among them are those who say: Its meaning is not correct in the language, and its meaning is fixed for it.

It was not forbidden to call him by that, because the Law did not forbid that for us, so it is an excuse. The third statement is correct; It is to differentiate between being called by names or being told about by them. So when he is called, he is not called except with the Most Beautiful Names, as God Almighty said: {And to Allah belong the Most Beautiful Names, so call upon Him by them, and leave those who deny His Names} [Al-A’raf: 180]

As for informing about it, it is according to need. If, in order to understand something other than what is meant, there is a need for its names to be translated into a language other than Arabic, or for it to be expressed by a name that has a correct meaning, This was not forbidden.

As for those who forbade it from the standpoint of reason, there are many: among them are those who say: The essence is that which occupies the space and carries the symptoms, and God - Glory be to Him. And God Almighty - that is not so, and this is the opinion of those of the theologians who denied that. And among them are those who say: If essence exists, its existence is not in a subject, and this only occurs in so far as its existence is in addition to itself. What is necessary for existence is its very existence, so it cannot be an essence. This is the opinion of Ibn Sina and other late philosophers like him.

As for the ancient philosophers; Like Aristotle and his likes; They used to call it jewel. It is from them that the Christians took this name. Aristotle was more than three hundred years before Christ, and for this reason these people said in their book: We are amazed at those who deny this, even though they He read some of the books of philosophers and logicians.

As for the language: the word “jawhar” is not from Arabic. For this reason, it is not known in pure Arabic speech, but rather it is Arabized, as Al-Jawhari and others mentioned. Al-Jawhari said: Al-Jawhari is Arabized. One is a jewel, so it is from the Arabized Arabic, not from the Arabized Arabic, like the word Sajil, Istabraq and similar things. Arabized words, and this word is not found in the Qur’an. However, when it was Arabized, its meaning in the language was the known essence.

Calling the person who is present in itself or the occupant of the space an essence is a conventional matter, and is not one of the linguistic or customary names. The general ones, not the legal names.

It has been said: It is taken from the words of the ancients, such as the Greeks and others, because in their words there is an essential name for the One Who is Almighty. It was said: They called him that; Because the essence of a thing is its origin, and what exists in itself is the origin. They may call the accident that exists with something else an essence. And it was said: Because the word “johar” is a verb, from the word “johar”. It is appearance and clarity, and the one who is the one who is responsible for himself appears and is known before the symptoms he has performed are known.

People agreed on confirming the existence of self-existing entities that are called essences or bodies, and they disputed regarding the affirmation of the symptoms that exist in them. According to their investigators, the dispute is verbal, as no rational person would dispute that a body moves after it has been at rest. But some of them say: Its movement is not in addition to itself. And among them are those who say: It is additional to itself. This is similar to their dispute over attributes: Are they additional to the essence or are they not additional? .

The truth is that when the term “man” is used, his attributes are included in it, and if a distinction is made between this and that, it is said: the essence and the attributes. Among the people are those who specialize in the word “accident” unless it is an essential attribute of what is described, and he calls the necessary attributes as intrinsic, intrinsic attributes. Among them are those who refer to an accident as something that does not last for two periods of time, and say: The attributes of a creature are called symptoms. Because they do not accept two periods of time other than the attributes of God, they are everlasting with Him, so they are not called symptoms.

Among the Muslim theorists are those who call the attributes of each described aspect, and if that is the case, then it is not included in the names of God that are mentioned in the foundations of faith. The names that should be thought to be the term of a group of people, even though it gives the impression of a false meaning. This is a situation in which many people were disturbed - along with the Christians.
Among them are those who make attributes into entities existing on their own and essences existing on their own.
Among them are those who make entities that exist by themselves into attributes, and attributes do not exist by themselves, but rather they must have a description by which they exist.

The first ones are of two types: Among them are those who denied the attributes and said: If We confirmed for Him life, knowledge, and power, it would be necessary for these to be gods. Eternity is the most specific of its description. If we affirm that it is not the essence, then it would have to share the essence in its most specific description, so it would be another existing entity. By herself. This is the way in which many of the Muslim innovators deny attributes, and the Jews and Christians protested against denying attributes by saying that if we affirmed them, They must be gods.

And those of those affiliated with Islam said: If we affirmed the attributes, we would have said what the Christians said, since they affirmed that the hypostases belong to God. The argument for these people is based on the Christians, who are the third type, because they affirmed attributes for God that they made an essence existing in itself, and they said: God exists, living and speaking. Then they said, “His life is a self-subsisting essence,” and His speech - which is the word - is a self-subsisting essence, and they said in This is: He is a god from a god, and this is a god from a god. So they confirmed the attributes of God and made them jewels standing on their own, then they said:

Everyone is an essence, so there were many false and contradictory things in their words. Among them are those who make attributes into essence. And among them are those who turn multiple gems into one essence.

And those who said, out of denial of the Mu'tazila and Jahmiyyah attributes: Indeed, whoever affirms the attributes has said what the Christians say, he is turning to the one who made Attributes are jewels. These are the Christians who claim that the attributes are the essences of gods. Then these people said: There is no god but Allah, so He has no attribute. The Christians said: Rather, the Father is the essence of God, and the Son is the essence of God, and the Holy Spirit is the essence of God. Then they said: And all are one God. The very concept of these sayings - the complete concept - necessitates knowledge of their corruption.

As for the messengers and their followers, they said that God has knowledge, power, and other attributes, and they affirmed that God is one God. So if the one who says: I worshiped God and called upon God; He only called and worshiped one God; He is a being endowed with the attributes of perfection. He did not worship a being that has no life, knowledge, or power, nor did he worship three gods or three jewels. Rather, the very name of God includes His holy and pure essence.

By His attributes - Glory be to Him - and His attributes are not external to the name of His name, nor are they additional to the name of His name. Rather, if He is decreed as an entity devoid of attributes, The attributes are in addition to this essence that is estimated in the mind, which is abstract from the attributes. Attributes are not additional to the essence that is characterized by the attributes. These cannot be achieved except through their attributes, so appreciating them - stripped of their attributes - is impossible.

The proof has been disputed: Should it be said that the attributes are the essence of the essence, or is it said that they are not the essence of the essence? Or is it said: It is not said that they are other than the essence, and it is not said that they are not other than the essence? And they disputed over the name of the two others: Are they what is permissible to separate from each other absolutely, or what is permissible to be separated by existence, time, or place? Or are they both? It is not permissible to know one of them while not knowing the other? The goal of this is verbal disputes.

Many of them made a difference in the necessary qualities between some of them and others. So He made some of them in addition to the essence and some of them not in addition to the essence, and the difference was according to what he imagined, not according to what was the matter with him in the matter. Himself. If they were able to imagine the essence without an attribute, they would say: This is additional. Otherwise, they would say: It is not additional. This implies that it is additional to what they imagined of the essence, not that there is an external entity devoid of that attribute, a quality. In addition to it, it is nothing but the self characterized by those qualities.

But there must be a difference between saying: The attributes are other than the essence, and saying: They are other than God. The name (God) is used to refer to Himself, which is characterized by His attributes. So if the one who says: I prayed to God and worshiped God; He did not call an abstract entity or abstract attributes, but rather He called an entity characterized by its attributes, and His name - the Almighty - addresses that. His attributes are neither external to the name of His name nor additional to that, even if it is said that they are additional to the abstract essence.

Whoever thinks that it is additional to the entity that is characterized by its attributes and whose attributes are included in its name, has made a mistake, but in the mind Tongues are very slippery in this place.
If it is said: Attributes are different from the essence, then there is nothing wrong with this as in our saying: The attributes of God are other than God. The name of God describes His attributes.

If it is said: It is something other than it; It is understood from this that it is different from him, and this is false. For this reason, they were rejected when they debated with the imams of the Muslims, as they debated with Imam Ahmad ibn Hanbal in his famous ordeal, and they said to him: “ What do you say about the Qur’an and the word of God? Is it God or other than God? He opposed them with knowledge. And he said to them: “What do you say about the knowledge of God? Is he God or someone other than God?” He also answered that the messengers did not speak of either of the two matters, so they have no proof in the words of God and His Messenger, for God did not say Because of his words: He is me, and he did not say: He is someone other than me!
Until the speaker says: If He made His words other than Him and something other than Him, then He has declared that He is the Creator of everything other than Him! .

If the evidence is based on hearing; There is no evidence for it, even if the evidence is based on reason. The reference in this matter is to the meanings, not to the expressions. If the person intending to say, “Are his speech and knowledge other than him” means that it is different from him. He is no one else in this regard. And if what he means by that is that the essence of speech and knowledge is not the speaking scholar; He is not entitled to this consideration. If the wording is general, it is not permissible to use it in a way that would give an incorrect meaning.

As for those who made existing entities by themselves attributes, they are these philosophers who are devoid of attributes and those like them; For they said: Indeed, the Lord of the Worlds is Reasonable, Reasonable, and Reasonable.

The word “mind” among them is even though they say: It is a self-existent essence, then they also declared that He - Himself - taught it, to the point that they declared That the Lord of the worlds knows, as Ibn Rushd and others stated, and they quoted it from Aristotle,

And the ten intellects, each one of them has knowledge, so it is knowledge, the knower, and the known. Rather, they said: an intellect, an intellect, an intelligible person, a lover, a lover, and a lover. And delicious, and pleasure, and pleasure, so they made him - himself - pleasure, reason, and love, and they made that the world, the lover and the pleasure, and they made that knowledge itself. The same love and the same pleasure; So they made Him - Himself - attributes, and they made Him an essence existing on its own, and they made every attribute the other, and this is what is known - with a clear mind - Its invalidity.

Some of them do not declare that he himself is knowledge, for he says: He is rational, reasonable, and rational. He says: He knows - Himself - without knowledge that He knows, but rather He is the Knower, and He is the Known and He is the Knowledge. The truth of their words goes back to what those people said; For if they say: The knowledge by which He knows Himself is the Knower and He is the known; They have made the same knowledge the same as the scholar, and the same knowledge as the known, and this is the truth of what those people say, and these matters are explained in other words. This place.

The second aspect: That it is said to them: You say that you follow the divine books, and if that is the case, then it is not appropriate for you in the Sharia. Your faith is from the names except what the Prophets, peace be upon them, brought.

And among the prophets, none of them called God a substance. Rather, Aristotle and others like him called it that, and these people were polytheists who worshiped God. Idols, and they did not know God correctly, nor did they say:

He is the Creator of the heavens and the earth, and He is All-Knowing of all things, nor is He Powerful over all things. Rather, they worshiped the stars above. And the lower idols, and they worship devils, and believe in the tyrant and the tyrant, but they only became believers when the religion of Christ entered upon them, prayers May God bless him and grant him peace, about three hundred years after Alexander of Macedon - the companion of Aristotle. And it is said:

He was the last of their kings (Ptolemy), and they used to call the king of their kings (Ptolemy) just as they called the Copts their king (Pharaoh). And Abyssinia was its king (Al-Najashi), and the Persians (Khosrau), and so on. Then will you turn away from the path of the prophets and messengers. To the way of the disbelievers and polytheists who are obstructed from clear misguidance.

And in their letters: When Paul went to Athens, the home of philosophers, and therein the home of idols, he found written on the door of the scholars’ home: The hidden and unknown God is the one who created the world.

They did not know the Lord of the worlds, so how could one change from the way of God’s messengers and prophets, such as Moses, David, and the Messiah, to the way of these people? The obstructive polytheist infidels? ! .

But the Christians combined a religion of two religions: the religion of the monotheist prophets and the religion of the polytheists, so a share of what she brought became in their religion. The prophets, and a portion of what they created from the religion of the polytheists in their words and deeds, just as they created the words of the hypostases, which are words It is not found in the words of the prophets, just as they introduced numbered idols instead of embodied idols, and prayer to the sun and the moon. And the planets, instead of praying to them and fasting in the springtime, to combine the legitimate religion with the natural matter, and so on.

The third aspect: Their saying: That which occupies space and accepts an accident is the dense substance, but as for the subtle substance, it is what accepts It is accidental and does not occupy space, like the essence of the soul, the essence of the mind, and the essence of light. It is said: talking about jewels. Is it divided into biased and unbiased or all of them biased? Connected to speech on the speaking soul of man.

So we say that Muslims are among the people who have the greatest knowledge of the existence of angels and jinn, as indicated by the Qur’an, the Sunnah, and the consensus of the nation. Likewise, the nation’s predecessors and imams knew of the existence of the soul, which is the human soul that leaves his body at the time of death, as he indicated that. The Qur’an, the Sunnah, and the consensus of the Salaf and Imams, even though many of the People of the Book claim that it is a symptom of the body, or part of Its parts, this is a new saying in Islam and none of the Salaf and Imams adhered to it, even if it was narrated on the authority of more than one person. Theologians, those who said this are not from the nation’s predecessors or its imams, but rather they are from the people of innovated speech that is reprehensible according to the predecessors.

The imams of the nation and many of the philosophers who belong to the people of religion say: The entities that the prophets call angels are those who Peripatetic philosophers call them minds, or minds and souls, and this is a great mistake, as has been explained in its place.

For the reasonings that these philosophers prove have no truth to the Messengers and their followers, nor even have any truth to the clear mind. Rather, the truth of what they say is that they are symptoms that exist on their own.

They declared that the necessary existence - itself - is knowledge, and they made the knowledge itself the knowledge itself, and the same interpretation of this statement. It is sufficient in knowledge of its corruption, just as these philosophers - followers of Aristotle - do not know the angels, or even the jinn, but rather their knowledge Knowledge of natural bodies, and they spoke about divine things with few and insignificant words; Its falsehood is greater than its truth, as has been explained in another place.

These people claim that the first intellect created the intellects and spheres below it until the matter comes down to the tenth intellect. He is the Creator of what is under the moon’s orbit. All of this is among the greatest forms of disbelief among the Messengers and their followers, the people of that religion. The content of this is that an angel among the angels created everything under the sky, and an angel above him created everything except God - Glory be to Him - and this is one of the greatest. Disbelief in the religion of the messengers and the Muslims, Jews and Christians. God Almighty said:

{And they say, “The Most Gracious has taken a son. Glory be to Him.” Rather, they are honored servants - they do not precede Him in word, and they do His command - He knows what is before them. And they are not behind them, nor do they intercede except for him whom He is pleased with, and they are in awe of Him.} [Al-Anbiya’: 26-28]
So he was told that the angels do not precede him in speech, and do not act except by his command, in addition to the fact that he is an angel who created everything.

These people say: The revelation and the words that the messengers brought are nothing but an outpouring of this effective mind on the hearts of the prophets. By God - the Almighty - in the presence of these people, he did not know Moses, Jesus, Abraham, Muhammad, or any of the other messengers, nor did he know the particulars. According to Aristotle and his followers: He does not know any of the things, nor, according to them, did He create anything. Indeed, according to them, He is not able to create anything. In addition to the fact that He has power over all things and that He has knowledge of all things.

Aristotle and his people were polytheists who worshiped idols in Macedonia, Athens and other cities of Greek philosophers, and he was a minister To Alexander the son of Philip the Macedonian. This was about three hundred years before Christ - peace be upon him - and he was not a minister of Al-Qarnayn who built the dam of Gog and Magog,

The general knowledge of the people is the science of nature and mathematics, and as for divine science - it is what they call the science beyond nature, and it is ultimate. Their philosophy - they only spoke about it in terms of general matters, dividing existence into an essence and nine symptoms, which are combined by the two verses of Zaid Al-Taweel Al-Aswad. Ibn Malik... in his house yesterday, there was a man lying in his hand, a sword that had sharpened and died... These are ten categories together, namely: essence, quantity, And how, and where, and when, and addition, and king, and situation, and to do, and to be moved.

His followers and others disputed this matter and said: There is no evidence for it. Some of them made it three. Among them are those who say otherwise and prove the first reason based on the motion of the orbit, and that it moves in a long motion, so it must have something He imitates him. The first cause is the purpose of the astronomy’s need for it, in that it moves in order to resemble it, like the movement of one who follows his imam. And the one who follows his example, and they may say: like a lover’s affection for his lover.

Aristotle's words on that matter are present, and I have quoted them in his own words and spoken about them elsewhere, and he mentioned that in an article Al-Lām, which is the last of his philosophy and the ultimate point of his wisdom.
And in the book Theology, “It has not been proven that the Lord is the Creator of an orbit or an efficient cause, nor is He called the Necessary Existent.”

He did not divide existing things into an ancient obligation and an ancient possibility. Rather, that was the action of the latecomers. Like Ibn Sina and his likes, and we have discussed them in detail elsewhere.

And the later scholars who heard the words of the people of religion wanted to correct his words and bring them closer to the minds, so that perhaps they would agree with what he knew with frank and reasonable reason. The narration is correct. Then Thabit ibn Qurra spoke about it and explained that the astronomy has no stability except by its nature, and its nature has no stability except by its movement, and no stability For his voluntary movement unless there is a driver for it.

They claimed that the engine must not be moving, and they decided this on the basis of corrupt evidence, and it has been widely discussed otherwise. location; They said: He only moved the orbit in terms of the relation of the orbit to him, even if he was not capable of moving the orbit, and indeed there was no awareness of it. By astronomy. This was expressed by Ibn Rushd, the philosopher and others like him. They said: He commands the ark to move and the ark to stand in obedience to God’s command.

Although with them he has no will and no knowledge of what he commands, but rather he is a commander, which is the meaning of the astronomy imitating him, just as The beloved commands his lover to love him, even if the beloved has neither the feeling nor the will to love him.

Then, if it were assumed that he was the one commanding it; It only occurs because of His command, the movement of the orbit; For this reason, they likened this to the Sultan’s order to his soldiers regarding an order that they would obey him, so they made the movements caused by this consideration. They did not prove Indeed, He created anything of the spheres, elements, generators, minds, or souls. He did not create their objects, nor their attributes, nor their actions, but rather His goal is to command her to move; Like the king’s command to his soldiers, even though to them he is not a true commander, rather he has no knowledge of any of the existing things, but rather the purpose of what he claims. Aristotle and his followers said that astronomy has a need for it in terms of its similarity to it, and as for the fact that it is a cause that causes astronomy, they only say This is what some of their later scholars, such as Ibn Sina, say.
As for Al-Farabi; He is the one who expanded the statement on this topic.

He divided existence into obligatory and possible, and made the spheres possible and obligatory with it, and in that there is corruption and confusion that has been spread elsewhere. This place. Ibn Sina based his statement on denying its attributes on the fact that it is necessary to exist.

As for Al-Farabi in the book “Opinions on the Virtuous City” and elsewhere, he relied on his being the first, and so did Aristotle in the book “Theology.” He relied on it being the first, and likened it to the first in number, and on that they based the negation of the attributes, but if we affirmed them, it would be out of the question. About it being first, even though they did not establish an argument for it being first in this sense that they claimed, just as they did not establish an argument for it being obligatory. Existence in the sense they claimed. Rather, they spoke in general, similar terms that carry truth and falsehood. For it is known that God is necessary to exist by Himself, and that He is the First, before whom there is nothing, and He is the Eternal and Eternal. The one who has not ceased to exist and will continue to exist. These people made the necessity of existence meaning that it is not related to anything else, so it does not have a characteristic.

And the fact that it is the first in the sense of the first of numbers in which there is no plurality, it is known that the One and the First, which is abstract from everything, is only valued in In the minds, not in the eyes.

The mind evaluates one, two, three, and four, in addition to all the abstract numbers, and the abstract number is found only in Minds, not in entities, as for what exists outside, they are entities existing in themselves and the attributes existing in them. The first of these is an entity characterized by attributes that are not found in objects. It is not an entity that exists by itself, nor an attribute that exists other than it, but rather There is no essence devoid of its attributes and these matters are explained elsewhere, but we have drawn attention here because these The people said, “We marvel at these people, for they are virtuous, polite, and knowledgeable.” And this is his appearance, having read some of the books. Philosophers and logicians, what right do they have to deny us this?

All the words of these Christians include glorification of philosophers and logicians, and that whoever reads their books recognizes in them the truth about the divine. What the rest of the religion does not know, and this indicates the ignorance of these Christians about what the Messengers brought, and what is known as pure reason.

As for the first: Because Christ and his followers are like the disciples and those who followed them, none of them venerated these philosophers, nor sought their help, nor Turn to them. Indeed, according to them, they are among the imams of disbelief and heads of misguidance, and so are Moses and his followers, and so are Muhammad and his followers, so it is not Among the Messengers of God and His Prophets, nor among their followers are there those who venerate them and do not seek help from their words. Rather, the Messengers and their followers agreed to mislead them. And make them ignorant.
As for mentalities:

Indeed, the words of these philosophers regarding the universal and divine sciences are magnified by those who are among the most ignorant of people regarding divine knowledge and sciences. College; Since what they said about that contained such ignorance and misguidance that no one can understand except the Majestic, but the people only knew what they knew. Of natural sciences and mathematics, such as geometry and some bodies, and some of the sciences of ethics and civil and domestic policies, which are Part of what the Messengers brought, and the Jews and Christians, after abrogation and alteration, are more knowledgeable than these regarding divine sciences and morals. And the policies, as well as what lies behind it.

The adherence of these Christians to these philosophers indicates their great ignorance of Islamic law and rationality, and this has simplified the discussion. On it in multiple places; The response to the philosophers was not limited to the Christians, but rather the discussion about it with them and with those whom he venerated among the people of that religion in general.

It is known that those affiliated with Islam are followers of philosophers. Like Al-Farabi, Ibn Sina, and Al-Suhrawardi who was killed, and Ibn Rushd, the grandson of their imam, he was more skilled and more knowledgeable than the Christians.

The books of philosophers that came to Islam, such as medicine, arithmetic, logic, and other things, were refined by those affiliated with Islam. Their words about it were better than the words of those Greeks.

Christians and Jews only rely in these sciences on what was described by those affiliated with Islam, even though these people at Muslim scholars are ignorant and misguided in matters of theology and universals, so how can their predecessors and those who honor them among the Jews and Christians be? .

And when those Greeks became acquainted with God, united with Him, worshiped Him, and believed in His angels, His books, and His messengers, when He entered into them Followers of Christ are called to the religion of God with which Christ was sent. And everyone who was a follower of Christ - without changing anything of his religion before abrogation - then he is among the guided believers, and they are among the saints. God, and they are among the people of Paradise.

And whoever thinks that the words of the apostles agree with these Greeks; This indicates his ignorance of what the messengers brought and what these people say. Such a thing is only found in the speech of atheists from among the people of that religion. Atheists of Jews, Christians, and others; Such as the Companions of the Messages of the Ikhwan al-Safa, and similar atheists who affiliated with Shiism or Sufism, such as Ibn Arabi and Ibn Sab’een. And their likes. And in the books that are subjected to criticism by people other than their rightful owners, and similar speech attributed to Abu Hamid, there is a fragment of that.

These people use as evidence the famous hadith: “The first time God created the mind, He said to it: Come.” So he approached, then he said to him: Turn around, so he turned around, and he said: By My Might, I have not created a creation more honorable to Me than you, for by You I take, by You I give, and by You I am rewarded. And the punishment is upon you.”
This hadith is a fabricated lie against the Prophet - may God bless him and grant him peace - as the people of knowledge of the hadith mentioned. Like Abu Jafar Al-Uqaili,
And Abi Hatim bin Hibban Al-Busti, Abi Al-Hasan Al-Daraqutni, Abi Al-Faraj bin Al-Jawzi and others.

Then his wording, if it were correct, is an argument that contradicts what they are asking, for he said: “The first thing that God created was the mind,” with the accusative case of “first,” and with the wording “first.” When God created the mind, He said to it.

His wording implies that He addressed Him the first thing He created, so they distorted His wording and said: The first thing that God created the mind was by Dhammah, and this is not His wording. But his wording implies that he addressed him at the first time of his creation. That is why he said: “I have not created a creation more honorable to me than you.” This implies that he created others before him.

According to them, it is the first of all creations, and it is impossible for anything to precede it, even though, according to them, it and all other intellects and spheres are ancient and eternal. It has ceased and will not cease.
Then he said: “By you I take, by you I give, by you is the reward, and upon you is the punishment.” So he made these four types with it.

According to them, the mind emanates the entire upper and lower world. This is because the word “mind” in the hadith, whether it is correct or weak, is the mind in the language of the prophets and messengers. The human being is an accident that exists in him, and this is a characteristic that exists in the human being. He is not an essence that exists in and of itself.

The mind, in the language of these philosophers, is a self-existent entity. As for the cosmic soul, they have two opinions about it: It was said: It is an accident that exists in the cosmos, and this is the view of most of them. It was said: Rather, it is a substance that exists in itself, and this is why Ibn Sina leans, and these matters are explained in another place.

What is meant here is for these Christians to mention that there is a gentle essence, other than a dense essence, and they represented that with the soul and mind. And light, then they did not provide any evidence to prove anything of that, nor any evidence of what the divine books have indicated, for the cosmic soul and intellects No book or messenger has uttered the ten things, nor has there been any rational evidence for them, and the philosophers’ evidence for them is weak. The mind only indicated what the angels told the messengers.

But those who carried the words of the apostles in accordance with the words of the philosophers make the preserved tablet the cosmic soul, as They make the mind and the pen the first mind and the throne the ninth sphere, and other than that which has been discussed in another place.

Since they did not establish a legal or rational argument for the beautiful essences they represented, they had no argument against those who said: The essence Something that takes up space and accepts an offer. When they linked the soul to the mind, it was clear that they wanted the cosmic soul.

As for if they meant the human soul, this is proven, and the messengers and their followers were informed of it, as has been explained in its place. But this is not linked to the mind, which is essence. The mind is an attribute of this, and it is the source of an intellect that intellects an intellect. What is meant by intellect is an instinct based on it, and what is meant by intellect is acting with knowledge, as it has been explained in another place.

The fourth aspect: Their saying: “And the essence of light.” So it is said to them: If by light you mean the same as the sun and fire, then this is a distinct body; It occupies a space and accepts an offer. It is not one of the delicate jewels that you represented, even if you wanted to use the light beam in the air. And the walls and the like, this is not an essence, neither fine nor dense, but rather it is a symptom existing in something else.

The fifth aspect: Your saying: “A gentle essence does not accept an accident” is forbidden words, and it is also false. The human soul accepts the symptoms that arise from it, and likewise the cosmic soul - according to those who affirmed it - is carried out by wills. And renewed perceptions. The word “accident” in the terminology of theorists means what was done by someone else, whether it was an intransitive or incidental attribute, and this necessitates the division of the Christians, as This is what philosophers say.

For they said: There is nothing in existence that is not either an essence or an accident. Because whatever matter we look at, we find it either existing by itself, not lacking in anything else for its existence, which is the essence, or it is lacking in Its existence is due to something other than itself, it has no substance by itself, and it is “the accident.” They said: “And it is not possible for these two to have a third part.”

This is what they said is the division of Aristotle and his followers, and he calls the first principle an essence, and this is the division of other theorists. But most of them do not include the Lord of the Worlds in the term “substance,” and some of them do include it, and some of the dispute over that is verbal.

And if the matter is as they said; The light that exists on the earth and the air is an accident, not an entity existing on its own, and they have made it an entity, and this is a clear contradiction. Also, beautiful jewels are used by symptoms; Like life and knowledge. Indeed, by the Lord - according to their saying - life and knowledge are sustained by Him.
If they call it essence, they are obligated to call its attributes accidents, if they say: There is nothing except essence or accident.

This contradicts their saying: “What exists is either an essence or an accident, for there is nothing in existing things except this or that.” Rather, the reason for their words is that it It is based on the essence of God, so what about the essence of someone else? .

And when they said: “And by accidents they mean the attributes that are incidental or existing in bodies,” this would be in contradiction to their saying: “Existent is either Essence or accident” with their saying: “The Lord is the essence of three persons, and the hypostasis is an entity” and with their saying: “The Lord is an essence.” Their saying implies that the Lord is an essence through which the symptoms occur, so how can there be anything other than Him?

Then it is said: If it is assumed that they claim to establish an essence that is not sustained by accidents, then this is a terminology of theirs in which they agreed to deny the attributes from Philosophers, such as Aristotle and his followers, say: God is an essence and is not characterized by any evident attributes, but this is not what the Christians say. So it became clear that in their saying: “Indeed, the Lord is an essence” and in their saying:

“Indeed, among the essences there are those that do not contain attributes.” They agree with the polytheist philosophers, Aristotle and his followers, but they do not agree with Christ. And the disciples, and that they confirmed the attributes of God in accordance with Christ and the disciples, then they made him an essence, then they said: “The subtle essence does not Attributes are created by Him.” This is the saying of the disruptive polytheist philosophers, and this is the fulfillment of what we mentioned about them, that they synthesized one religion from another religion. Christ and the disciples and from the religion of the polytheist infidels.

If they mean by accident, then every substance accepts attributes, and if they mean by accident what the philosophers mean by accidental attributes Which they differentiate from the essence - although this is not what they say - we have mentioned elsewhere that the division of these The necessary attributes of what is described are divided into intrinsic and accidental, a false division, and destining it to be true. The soul - also - accepts accidental attributes, rather The same applies to every substance, whether it is fine or dense. So your saying:

“The subtle essence does not accept accidents, such as the essence of the soul, the essence of the mind, the essence of light, and the things that flow through this path. Delicate gems, completely empty talk.

And if they meant something else by the word accident, that would not benefit them, for the theologians who said: “The essence is that which occupies a space.” And it is accepted as accidental. “They only meant by accident that which stands with other meanings, whether necessary for it or incidental to it, and it is known that every essence It is based on the meanings. And the Creator - the Most High - according to them is carried out by modesty and knowledge. If the Creator - the Most High - is carried out by meanings - and they call it essence - So how can meanings not be based on anything else?

These people affirm a subtle essence that is not supported by symptoms, while they say: “It is based on meanings,” and this is a terminology of theirs that does not Someone agrees with them. Then they contradict themselves and say: “Whatever exists is either essence or accident,” and this is a contradiction.

There is a dispute among the Muslim scholars regarding calling the attributes of God that exist in Him as symptoms: some of them call them symptoms, and some of them deny this. Naming, with these two sects agreeing to attribute the attributes to it. The majority of Muslim theorists do not call it essence, and some of them call it essence, but as for whoever denies that attributes are created by it, he does not call it essence. God is neither substance nor body.
These Christians are clearly contradictory, and that is why they had a method with which none of the sects of rational people agree with them. Shows:.

In the sixth aspect: which is that people have two opinions in proving the attributes that are based on the essence of God Almighty: the predecessors of the Muslims and their imams. The majority of people, both people of that religion and non-people of that religion, affirm the existence of attributes in God, Blessed and Most High. Are they called symptoms? On two sayings: The second saying: The saying of those who deny attributes, such as the Jahmite atheists and the like, from among the innovators of the Muslims, and those who The most well-versed among them are philosophers, and some Jews and Christians. For these people, meanings and attributes do not relate to it, so they do not say: it does. Symptoms.
Then among them are those who call it an essence, such as Aristotle and his followers, and among them are those who do not call it an essence, such as the later philosophers: Ibn Sina.
And others like him, along with the majority of Muslim theorists and others, whether they call it a substance or not.

As for the majority of people who say that meanings are based on meanings; Some of them call it symptoms, even if they do not call it essence. Some of them have called it essence, some of them deny that it is symptoms, and some of them are silent about denying or confirming it, so they do not call it symptoms. The speaker does not deny calling them that, or deny the fact that they are symptoms.

As for these Christians, they said: “The essence of three persons,” and they described it with immutable attributes. It is life and speech, and they said: “Whatever exists is either an essence or an accident,” so they required that God’s attributes be accidents to them, then they said: “ A subtle essence cannot be supported by accidents.” And they exalted the Lord that accidents should support it. With their saying: “It is an essence,” they were in a clear contradiction. Where they combined the words of the messengers and their followers with the words of the obstructive polytheists and philosophers.

What they received about Christ is truth, and what they invented in the words of those who disagreed with the apostles is false. In what they said, they combined truth and falsehood, and they followed a path that is not known from others. This can be explained by saying:

The seventh aspect: This what they mentioned is a clear contradiction. For they said: What exists is either essence or accident: “What exists by itself is essence, and what exists other than it is accident.”

Then they said: “He exists, living and speaking. He has life and speech.” Then it will be said to them: His life and speech. Either it is an essence or an accident, and it is not an essence. Because the substance did not arise by itself, and life and speech do not arise by themselves, but rather by something else, they are among the symptoms, so it was determined that They have an essence through which accidents arise, even though they say: “It is an essence that does not accept accidents.”

If it was said: They meant when they said: “He does not accept an offer,” it would not have happened; It was said: This contradicts their existing division into essence and accident, for the ancient meaning that underlies it is neither essence nor an event. If it is an accident; So he made the offer and accepted it, even if it was not an offer; The division was invalidated.

This shows that it is said: You said: “He is a living, speaking thing,” and you said: “He is three persons,” and you said: “He who is united with Christ.” “I fulfill the word” and you said in faithfulness: “We believe in one God, the Father, Almighty, and in one Lord, Jesus Christ, the only Son of God.” “Begotten of the Father before all ages, true God from true God, of the essence of his Father, begotten, not created, of one essence with the Father.”

Then you said: “The Lord is a substance,” and you said: “That which occupies space or accepts an accident is the dense substance; as for the subtle substance, it is not It accepts an accident and does not occupy a space, such as the essence of the soul and the essence of the mind, and what flows through this stream of subtle essences The delicate and dense gems that were created would not accept an accident or occupy space, so the Creator of the subtle and dense gems was The dense things that are condensed are incidentally accepted and occupy a space. “So you declared that it is a substance that does not accept incidentally, and you said:

“There is nothing in an existing entity that is not either an essence or an accident. If it exists by itself and is not in need of anything else for its existence, then it is The essence, even if it lacks in its existence something else and has no substance on its own, then it is the accident.”

Then it will be said to you: The ancient and eternal Son, who was born of the essence of his Father - who was begotten, not created, who was incarnate and descended - a subsisting essence. By itself, or is it an accident existing in something else? What exists with you is either an essence or an accident. If you say: He is a substance, then you have clearly proven two essences: the Father is a substance, and the Son is a substance, and then he will be the hypostasis of life. A third essence. This is a statement proving three self-existing gems, and in that case your statement is invalid:
“He is one God, and He is a single entity with three attributes, and He is one in essence with three hypostases” since you had declared - on This estimate - by proving three jewels.

And if you say: Rather, the Son, ancient and everlasting, who is the Word, which is knowledge and wisdom, is an accident existing in the essence of the Father, it is not He. a second essence; You have declared that the Lord is an essence by which the accidents exist, and you denied this in your speech, and said: “He is an essence by which you do not exist.” Symptoms” And you said: “Indeed, among the created beings there are substances that cannot be caused by accidents, so the Creator is better.” This is a clear contradiction in which there is no solution. For those who reflect on their words, the beginning and the end.
Their words necessitate that it is one essence, with no accidents associated with it.

They say: “One essence, three hypostases,” whether they call them qualities, properties, or symptoms, or they say: The hypostasis is the essence. And the adjective. So it is said to them: The Lord is with the Persons: three essences, or one essence with three attributes, or one essence that has no attributes. If they say: Three essences, they prove three, and their saying: “The Lord is one essence and one God” is invalid, and they declared that three are proven. Gods.

And if they say: Rather, it is one essence with three attributes, then they have declared that this essence is supported by the attributes, and if the attributes are supported by it - and they They called it an essence - and they said: “Everything that exists is either an essence or an accident.” They absolutely required that its attributes be accidents, so their saying: “It is An essence that is not sustained by accidents.” And if they say: It is a single essence that is not sustained by attributes. Their statement is false:

“Has life and speech.” And when they deny the attributes; They invalidated the trinity and the union, and the trust was invalidated, despite their violation of the books of the prophets, for they clearly confirm the attributes, and with Their violation of clear reason.

What is meant is that they are in clear contradiction. Because they proved an essence that accidents do not exist, with their saying: “What exists is either an essence or an accident” and with their saying: “It is Essence of Three Persons: “If the symptoms do not exist in it, it does not have any attributes, for the attribute existing without it is not an essence, but rather it is - if What exists is either an essence or an accident - from the category of accidents, not from the category of essences, so this speech denied the existence of attributes in it. Absolutely.

Then they said about the hypostases, which necessitates either the affirmation of attributes, or the affirmation of three essences existing by themselves, although if they exist By themselves, it must be characterized by attributes. There is no doubt that the people combine in their statement the two opposites, between affirming and denying the attributes, and affirming the three jewels of three gods. And their saying is one God.

The reason for that: They created a belief for themselves, some of it from the precise texts of the prophets, such as their saying: “One God,” and some of it from Their words are similar, such as the words (the Son) and (the Holy Spirit), and some of them are from the words of the obstructive polytheist philosophers, such as their saying: “An essence that you cannot do.” “Attributes.”

What explains this is that you find that most Christian scholars - let alone the general public - do not know what Christ abrogated from the law of the Torah. He approved it, even though they agreed that Christ did not abrogate it all, nor did he approve of it all. Rather, he told them that he had only come to fulfill it. To invalidate it, and he made lawful some of what was forbidden in it, such as working on the Sabbath.

It is known that what is meant by the messengers is to believe them in what they were told, and to obey them in what they were commanded, so if the generality of Christians do not distinguish what He commanded them to do what he did not command them to do, nor did he forbid them to do what he did not forbid them - with their acknowledgment that he approved many of the The law of the Torah. Rather, He multiplied it and made some of it lawful, so He abrogated it and elevated it, and they did not know this from this. They did not know what came. Through it is the Messiah, and they do not know what God commanded them through Moses and the other prophets - for it is not permissible for them to do everything in the Torah. Christ abrogated some of that with their agreement and the agreement of Muslims on that.

It is not permissible for them to nullify all the law of the Torah, but rather they must act on what Christ did not abrogate, and their common people do not know what he abrogated. Which He did not abrogate, so it is not possible for them to work with the Torah and benefit from it according to Sharia law, until they know what has been abrogated from it and what has not been abrogated.

And their common people did not know that, for they were not at that time following a law sent down from God, neither by Christ, nor by Moses. They knew it, but it was unknown to their common people and the public or all of them, so they needed to know what God had legislated from what He did not legislate it; So God sent Muhammad - may God bless him and grant him peace - with a law in which he enjoined the virtues of what was in the two books, and replaced what he abrogated with something better than it.

chapters.title: A chapter refuting their claim to dispense with Judaism and Christianity
paragraphs: [Chapter: Nullifying their claim to be self-sufficient with Judaism and Christianity]
Chapter Then they said: “We are amazed at these people, who, despite their manners and the virtue with which they take themselves, how could they not know The laws are two laws:

A law of justice and a law of virtue; Because since the Creator was just and generous, it was necessary for him to show his justice to his creation, so he sent Moses to the children of Israel and established the law of justice. He ordered them to do it until it settled in their souls, and since perfection, which is virtue, cannot be achieved by anyone except the one who has completed perfection, It must be He - His names are sanctified and His rewards are majestic - who places it; Because there is nothing more perfect than him, and because he is generous; He must provide for the sake of existing things, and there is nothing more perfect than His word in existing things. That is why he must be faithful to his word, that is why he must be faithful to his word, that is why he must be united with a tangible entity that shows Among them are His power and His presence.

And since there was no creature greater than man, he was united with human nature from the pure Lady, from the virgin Mary, chosen to be Women of the worlds, and after this perfection there is nothing left to be created; because

Everything that precedes it and what comes is its requirement, and everything that comes after completion is not in need of it; Because nothing comes after perfection and is virtuous, but rather inferior, or taken from it. He is virtuous and does not need it, and there is benefit in this saying. And peace be upon whoever follows guidance, and this is from what I knew of the people whom I saw and spoke to regarding Muhammad - peace be upon him - and what They use it as evidence on their own behalf, if what they mentioned is true; Praise be to God. If it is otherwise, then our Lord will write it down. They have made me an ambassador, and praise be to God, Lord of the worlds.”

The answer to this has several aspects, one of which is: to say: Rather, there are three laws: a law of justice only, a law of virtue only, and a law that combines Justice and virtue, so it necessitates justice and encourages virtue. This is the most complete of the three laws, and it is the law of the Qur’an in which the Justice and virtue. Although we do not deny that Moses - peace be upon him - enjoined justice and encouraged virtue, and likewise Christ - also - enjoined justice. And he lamented to virtue.

As for those who say that Christ enjoined benevolence and forbade every oppressed person to take revenge on his oppressor, or that Moses did not entrust Charity, this is a violation of the law of the messengers. But it may be said: Justice is mentioned more in the Torah, and virtue is mentioned more in the Gospel, and the Qur’an combines them with the utmost perfection.

The Qur’an makes it clear that the happy people are the people of Paradise, and they are the guardians of God of two types: the righteous and thrifty, and those who are brought near and foremost; The first degree is achieved through justice, which is performing duties and abandoning forbidden things, and the second degree is only achieved through grace, which is performance. Obligatory and recommended duties, and abandoning forbidden and disliked things.
The complete Sharia combines justice and virtue. As God Almighty says: {And if it is a difficult situation, then look for an easy one} [Al-Baqarah: 280].
This is obligatory justice, and whoever deviates from it deserves punishment in this world and the hereafter.
Then he said: {And that you give in charity is better for you, if you only knew} [Al-Baqarah: 280].
This is a desirable and recommended virtue. Whoever does it, God will reward him and raise his status, and whoever abandons it will not punish him.
And He - the Almighty - said:.
{And whoever kills a believer by mistake, the freeing of a believing slave shall be a blood money delivered to his family} [An-Nisa: 92].
This is fair.
Then He - the Almighty - said: {Unless they give charity} [An-Nisa: 92].
This is a virtue.
And He - the Almighty - said:.
{And wounds are retaliation} [Al-Maeda: 45].
This is fair.
Then he said:.
{So whoever gives it in charity, it will be an expiation for him} [Al-Ma’idah: 45].
This is a virtue.
And He - the Almighty - said:.
{And if you divorce them before you have touched them, and you have appointed for them an obligation, then half of what you have appointed} [Al-Baqarah: 237].
This is fair.
Then he said:.
{Unless they pardon, or He in whose hand is the marriage contract pardons, but that you pardon is closer to piety} [Al-Baqarah: 237].
This is a virtue.
And He - the Almighty - said:.
{And if you punish, then punish with the same as that with which you were punished} [An-Nahl: 126].
This is fair.
Then he said:.
{And if you are patient, it is better for those who are patient} [An-Nahl: 126].
This is a virtue.
And He - the Almighty - said.
{And the recompense for an evil is an evil like it} [Al-Shura: 40].
This is fair.
Then he said:.
{So whoever pardons and makes amends, his reward is with Allah} [Al-Shura: 40].
This is a virtue.

And He - Glory be to Him - always forbids injustice, requires justice, and encourages virtue, as at the end of Surat Al-Baqarah when he mentioned the ruling on wealth. And the people therein are either benevolent, just, or unjust. The benefactor is the one who gives charity, the just one who compensates is like the seller, and the unjust is like the usurer.

So he began with benevolence and charity, and he mentioned that and desired it and said: {The likeness of those who spend their wealth in the cause of God is like a seed that has sprouted. Seven ears of corn, in each ear there are a hundred grains, and God multiplies for whom He wills, and God is All-Encompassing, All-Knowing - those who spend their money in the path of God, then They will not be followed back for what they have spent, nor will any harm befall them. Their reward is with their Lord, and there will be no fear upon them, nor will they grieve - a well-known word and forgiveness. Better than charity followed by harm, and God is Rich, Forbearing} [Al-Baqarah: 261-263] verses.

Then he mentioned the prohibition of usury, and said: “Those who devour usury will not stand except as one whom Satan causes to trouble because of the touch of that person stands.” Because they said, “Trade is only like usury.” And God has permitted trade and forbidden usury. So whoever has come to him an admonition from his Lord and desisted, he will have what he had previously paid. And his affair is up to God, and whoever turns back - those are the inmates of the Fire, they will abide therein forever.” [Al-Baqarah: 275].

Then, when the sale became permissible, he mentioned the debts, and the ruling on immediate and deferred sales, and he preserved that by writing, witnesses, or mortgage, and concluded The Surah describes the principles of faith, including belief in the Books and Messengers, and He - Glory be to Him - after opening it by mentioning the types of people, and they are three: either Either a believer or an unbeliever or a hypocrite. So he mentioned the description of the believers, then he mentioned the description of the unbelievers, then he mentioned the description of the hypocrites, then he laid out the foundations of faith; So he commanded the worship of God Almighty and mentioned His signs and blessings.

Then he established the prophecy of his messengers, then he mentioned the Last Day and the promise and the threat, then he mentioned the beginning of the world and the creation of the heavens and the earth, then he created Adam and the angels prostrating to him, his exit from Paradise, and his descent to earth.

Then, after spreading the call to all of creation, he singled out the People of the Book and addressed them: He addressed the Jews first, the Children of Israel, then the Christians, then He addressed the believers and determined for them the rules of his religion. So he mentioned the origin of the religion of Abraham, his building of the House, and his supplication for the people of Mecca, and he emphasized the matter with the religion of Abraham, then he mentioned what is related to towards the House, from taking it as a qibla and from venerating the rituals of God that are with Him, such as Safa and Marwah, then mentioning monotheism and what is permissible and what is forbidden. Restaurants are for people in general, and then for those who believe in particular.

Then he mentioned what is related to murder as a form of retaliation and death as a will. Then he mentioned the laws of religion, so he mentioned fasting the month of Ramadan, and what There is seclusion in it, then he mentioned what is related to the month of fasting, which is the month of Hajj, so he mentioned Hajj, and he mentioned the ruling on fighting in general, Especially in the Sacred Land. When he mentioned prayer, fasting, Hajj, jihad, and charity, he then mentioned what is permissible and what is forbidden in private parts. He mentioned the rulings on intercourse with women, menstruation, sexual intercourse with women, divorce with them, and khula’ with them.

He mentioned the ruling on children and their breastfeeding, and women’s iddah and engagement to them during the waiting period, and their divorce before and after consummation. Then he mentioned Prayers and observing them, then he decided on the Day of Resurrection and what it indicates in terms of the resurrection of the dead in this world time after time.

So this one Surah included everything that people need in the religion, its origins and branches, and it opened with belief in the books and the messengers. He concluded it with faith in the Scriptures and the Messengers, and concluded it with faith in the Scriptures and the Messengers. Faith in the Scriptures and the Messengers is the pillar, base, and foundation of faith.

In it He commanded creation in general and in particular, and He mentioned in it faith in the Creator and the signs of His Lordship, and faith in the Day of Resurrection and the Hereafter. And the good deeds that He commanded, and those who were among the followers of the Messengers were believers, Jews, and Christians.

And the Sabians adhere to these principles: which is faith in God and the Last Day, and good deeds are happy in the Hereafter, which will have its reward. With his Lord, and there is no fear for them, nor do they grieve.

Other than those among them who changed the Book, or denied the Book, then these are among the disbelievers. Whoever followed the law of the Torah before the Messiah was sent, without changing it, is one of the happy ones. Likewise, whoever followed the law of the Gospel before the sending of Muhammad - may God bless him and grant him peace - without changing it, then he is among the happy ones.

And whoever changes the law of the Torah or denies Christ is an unbeliever, like the Jews after the sending of Christ - peace be upon him - and likewise whoever changes the law If he rejects the Gospel or rejects Muhammad - may God bless him and grant him peace - then he is an infidel like the Christians after the sending of Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace.

The ancient Jews and Christians who followed the religion before abrogation and alteration were happy, and as for the Jews and Christians who adhered to a changed law abrogated and they abandoned following the Book and the Messenger who was sent to them and to others and turned away from the decisive revealed law, so they are disbelievers.
He rejected the false claims of the Jews and Christians, such as their saying: “None will enter Paradise except he who is a Hud” [Al-Baqarah: 111].
And these people say: Only those who are Christians will enter Paradise, so he said:.
{Indeed, whoever submits his face to God and is a doer of good will have his reward with his Lord, and there is no fear upon them, nor shall they grieve} [Al-Baqarah: 112].
He made clear the disbelief of the Jews and Christians, from what their condition was known to be.

But most of what was mentioned in this Surah: the Jews, just as most of what was mentioned in Surah Al Imran are the Christians, for this was revealed for the first time. Its beginning was the city, and the Jews were its neighbors.

And the descending of the family of Imran was delayed until the end, when the Christians of Najran came to it, and the Hajj was made obligatory there, when God purified Mecca of The polytheists, so most of his supplication in the beginning was for the polytheists. Because they are his neighbors in Mecca, and then to the Jews; Because they are his neighbors in the city, and then to the Christians; Because they were farther away from him in the region of the Levant and Yemen, and the Magi - also - because they were farther away from him in the land of Iraq. And Khorasan.

This is the appropriate order: He calls those closest to him, then those closest to him, then he sends his messengers to those farthest away. And he - may God bless him and grant him peace - was - firstly - busy with jihad against the polytheists and the Jews. When he made peace with the polytheists, he made peace with Hudaybiyyah, and he fought the Jews of Khaybar after that, so God granted him victory and divided it among those who pledged allegiance to him under Al-Shajara: Those who witnessed the Treaty of Hudaybiyyah. He devoted himself to those who came after him, so he sent his messengers to all the nations around him.

He was sent to the Christian kings of Egypt, the Levant, and Abyssinia, for the Negus king of Abyssinia, who had converted to Islam, had died, and he informed the people By his death, the day he died, he went out with his companions to the outskirts of the city and prayed the funeral prayer over him, just as he prayed over all the dead. Muslims. After the Negus, another took office and sent to him, as Muslim mentioned in his Sahih, and he was sent to the kings of Yemen, both the polytheists and the Jews, and to Arab kings.

And there was among the Arabs a large group of Jews, a large group of Christians, and a large group of Magians. So he called all of the people, including the Jews, the Christians, and the Magians. And the polytheists, Arabs and non-Arabs.

Either they believe in Him inwardly and outwardly - and they are the pious friends of God, His successful party, and His victorious soldiers - or they submit to Him in The apparent appearance is piety and fear of his nation, and they are hypocrites.

And whenever a person and a group of his nation adhered to his religion, his light was apparent and his proof was brilliant, magnified, and victorious. His superiority over all was known. Who else?

This is something known to the people in the land of the infidels, both the polytheists and the People of the Book. Because of what God allocated to Muhammad - may God bless him and grant him peace - and his nation for guidance and the religion of truth. They have demonstrated the religion of the Lord in the east and west of the earth, in word and deed. Would someone who has knowledge and justice say that there is no benefit in sending Muhammad - may God bless him and grant him peace - and that he is dispensed with what the people of Is the book about its message? !

The ninth aspect: It is said: They acknowledge that the polytheists benefited from it to the utmost benefit, for it established the monotheism of God and His religion in them. And he venerated Christ. He responded to what the Jews said about him and insulted them, and then this is one of the greatest benefits, the greatest of goals, and the greatest of God’s blessings upon His servants, then he - despite that - said: God sent him and commanded him to do that.

If he is a liar, then he is a liar who slanders God about the evil of the disbelievers, and whoever is like that will not achieve this great good from him, which did not happen. The like of any of the prophets, for he removed the religion of the polytheists, the religion of the Magians, and suppressed the Jews, and each of these three did not No one of the prophets and messengers before him could do it.

And if he is honest; He was informed that he is the Messenger of God to the Christians and other nations, and he was informed on behalf of God of the disbelief of all who do not believe in Him. This is the aspect with which every class of nations is addressed, so it is said of every class of nations:

You acknowledge that if those other than you follow the religion of Muhammad - may God bless him and grant him peace - it will be better for them than what they are following; The Jews acknowledge that if the Christians follow it, it will be better for them than the religion of the Christians, and the Christians acknowledge that if the Jews follow it, It was better for them than the religion of the Jews, and the People of the Book, the Jews and Christians, acknowledge that if anyone other than them follows Muhammad, it is better. They have what they are.

So the Magians and polytheists from the Arabs, the Sudan, the Turks, the Khazars and the Saqlabiyya, if they follow it, it will be better for them than what they are upon. And all types of infidels acknowledge that his followers are better than others. And those who are not among the People of the Book - the general public - acknowledge that the religion of the Muslims is better than the religion of the Jews and Christians. Then it will be said: Whoever brings this religion, which all the people of the earth prefer over anything else, must not be among the most disbelieving and most deserving of people. With God's wrath and punishment. And everyone who said:

He is the Messenger of God; If he is truthful, then he is among the best of the people of the earth and most deserving of God’s pleasure and reward, and if he is lying, then he is among the worst of the people of the earth. And they deserve the wrath and punishment of God. Whoever attains this goodness, knowledge, and guidance, and what is in it for the good of this world and the hereafter, is greater than what he attained from all of creation, he will not be He is one of the most disbelieving people deserving of God’s wrath and punishment, so he must be among the best of the people of the earth. Indeed, he is the best of the people of the earth. And they are most deserving of God’s pleasure and reward.

The tenth aspect: God - Glory be to Him, the Most High - was His way before the revelation of the Torah. If one of the prophets lies, God takes revenge on him. His enemies with a torment from Him, just as He destroyed the people of Noah by drowning, and the people of Hud by the roaring wind, and the people of Salih by shouting, and the people of Shuaib with shade, and Lot's people with the count, and Pharaoh's people with drowning. God Almighty said: {And We gave Moses the Scripture after We had destroyed the first centuries. Insights for people and guidance and mercy so that they may remember} [Al-Qasas: 43].
When He sent down the Torah, He commanded the People of the Book to wage jihad. Some of them disobeyed, and some of them obeyed.

The purpose of the message became that it could not be achieved except with knowledge and ability, as God Almighty said: {It is He who has sent His Messenger with guidance and the religion of truth. That He may make it prevail over all religion, and Allah is sufficient as a witness} [Al-Fath: 28].
These people say: “The Torah brought justice, and the Gospel brought grace, so there is no need for anything else, if it is determined to be true.

It would only be valid if the two books had not been changed, but rather they were followed in knowledge and practice, and their people were nonetheless victorious and supportive of those who He differed from them, so how come when much of what was in each of them has been changed, and their families are not victorious over the rest of the disbelievers, but rather the disbelievers are victorious over them in multiply the earth; Such as the land of Yemen, Hijaz, and the rest of the Arabian Peninsula, and the land of Iraq, Khorasan, and Morocco, and the land of India, Sindh, and Turks, and it was At the hands of the People of the Book, the Levant, Egypt, and other than that, and despite this, the Persians had defeated them in that,, then God made the Christians Upon them, their appearance was a prelude and prelude to the manifestation of the religion of Islam.

When the Persian Magians defeated the Romans, that displeased the Prophet - may God bless him and grant him peace - and those who believe in him, and the Arab polytheists rejoiced at that, and they were More than believers; Because the People of the Book are closer to the believers than the Magians, and the Magians are closer to the polytheists than they are to the People of the Book, and God has promised Believers that the Romans will be defeated after that, and that on that day the believers will rejoice in God’s victory.

So he added Al-Nusrah to the name of God, and did not say, “By God’s help to them.” This is because when the Romans defeated Persia, the Prophet - may God bless him and grant him peace - and his companions defeated the polytheists and the Jews.

At that time, the Prophet - may God bless him and grant him peace - sent a call to the Christian kings of the Levant and Egypt to believe in him, so they knew him and knew that he was the prophet bringing good tidings. With him, and that was the first appearance of his religion, then he sent a group of his companions to others, then he brought out the Muslims himself with them in the year Tabuk to the Levant, then its people conquered this country, which was to support the religion of God and its appearance and to humiliate the polytheists, the Magians and others. From the infidels at his hands and the hands of his nation, not at the hands of the Jews and Christians.

If it had been determined that the law of those people was perfect and could not be changed, he would have been defeated and subjugated, and God had sent someone who would confirm his religion and make it apparent, so how? Is it changed? And if the religion of Ahmad had not been changed, more perfect and better than that, then that one was lost and was replaced, and this one was virtuous and was not changed, and that one was defeated and subjugated. This is Muayyad Mansour. And through some of this, you will benefit from sending it.
It was for the sake of benefits that Muhammad was sent - may God bless him and grant him peace - so how can it be said: There is no benefit in sending him?

The eleventh aspect: Their saying: “Since the Creator is just and generous, it is obligatory for him to demonstrate his justice.” So it is said to them: the generosity of the generous. Other than obliging people to give up their rights, because the generous one is the one who does good to people, not the one who forces people to give up their rights, and these They claim that the law of the Bible obligates people to give up their rights, and that an oppressed person is not treated fairly by his oppressor, and for this reason they have no ruling. Justice with which they judge between people. Rather, there are two rulings for them: the ruling of the church, and it does not involve fairness to the oppressed from the oppressor. And the second:
The rule of kings, and it is not a revealed law, but rather it is according to the opinions of the kings.

That is why you find them returning the people to the rule of Islamic law in blood, wealth, and the like, until in some of their countries the king is The soldiers are all Christians, and there is a small group among them who are Muslims. They have a ruler, so they return the people in blood and treasure to the rule of Sharia law.
