I was eager to support you when your people expelled you. He said: Or are they my expellers? He said: No one has brought anything like what you have brought except me, and if your day overtakes me, I will support you with a strong victory. Then he did not raise the paper to say: "He passed away."

Ibn Ishaq said: “Twenty men - or close to that - came to the Messenger of God - may God bless him and grant him peace - while he was in Mecca among the Christians. News about him in Abyssinia emerged, and they found him in the council, so they spoke to him and asked him and men from Quraysh in their clubs.

When they finished asking the Messenger of God - may God bless him and grant him peace - about what they wanted, the Messenger of God - may God bless him and grant him peace - called them to God Almighty. And He recited the Qur’an to them, and when they heard it, their eyes overflowed with tears. Then they responded to him and believed in him and believed him, and they learned from him what was being described. They recorded his matter in their writings, so when they got up from him, Abu Jahl confronted them about a group of Quraysh, and they said:

May God let you down. He sent behind you some of your people of religion to go back to them and bring them the news of the man, but your gatherings were not reassured. He was with him until you left your religion and believed what he told you? ! We do not know any people more foolish than you - or as they said to them - and they said: “Peace be upon you. We will not be ignorant of you. We have our works and you have your works.” It is said: Among them was revealed the Almighty’s saying:

{Those to whom We gave the Scripture before it, they believe in it. And when it is recited to them, they say, “We believe in it. It is the truth from our Lord. Indeed, we were of Before him, they were Muslims.} [Al-Qasas: 52] »

On the authority of Muhammad bin Omar bin Ibrahim bin Muhammad bin Jubayr: My grandmother, Umm Uthman bint Sa’id bin Muhammad bin Jubayr, told me on the authority of her father Sa’id. Ibn Muhammad Ibn Jubayr Ibn Mut’im, on the authority of his father, said: I heard my father Jubayr saying: When God sent His Prophet and His command became known in Mecca, I went out to Damascus. When I was in Busra, a group of Christians came to me and said to me: Are you from the Haram? I said: Yes. They said: Do you know this man who prophesied among you? I said: Yes, he said: Then they took me by the hand and took me into a monastery where they had statues and pictures, and they said to me:
See, do you see the image of this prophet who was sent to you? So I looked and did not see his image. I said: I do not see his image.

So they took me into a monastery larger than that monastery, in which there were more images than in that monastery, and they said to me: Look, do you see his image? So I looked, and behold, I was in the capacity of the Messenger of God - may God bless him and grant him peace - and his image, and behold, I was in the capacity of Abu Bakr and his image, and he was taking After the Messenger of God - may God bless him and grant him peace - they said to me: Look, do you see his characteristic? I said: Yes, they said: Is this? They pointed to the description of the Messenger of God - may God bless him and grant him peace - and I said: Oh God, yes. I bear witness that it is he. They said: Do you know this one who took his heel? I said: Yes.

They said: We bear witness that this is your friend, and that this is the caliph after him. It was narrated by Al-Bukhari in his history, and he said in it: The one I see said Pictures: There was no prophet except that there was another prophet after him, except this prophet. It was narrated by Abu Naim in the evidence of prophecy.

Musa bin Uqba narrated that Hisham bin Al-Aas, Nu'aym bin Abdullah, and another man whom he named, were sent to the king of the Romans at the time of Abu Bakr. He said: So we entered Jablah bin Al-Ayham while he was in Al-Ghouta, and he mentioned the hadith.

And that he took them to the king, and that they found with him something like a great quadrangle, gilded, and, behold, in it were small doors, so he opened them. A door, from which he took out a black silk cloth, with a white image, and mentioned the characteristic of Adam. Then he opened another door, from which he took out a silk cloth, with a white image in it. The image of Noah, then Abraham, then he showed them Harirah, in which was the image of Muhammad - may God bless him and grant him peace - and said:

This is the last chapter, but I hastened it. To see what you have. Then he opened other doors and showed them the image of the rest of the prophets. Moses, Aaron, David, Solomon, and Jesus son of Mary - peace be upon them - the description of Lot, the description of Isaac, and he mentioned that this is with them In the past, since the time of Adam, and Daniel depicted it clearly.

Something like this was narrated on the authority of Al-Mughirah bin Shu’bah, that when he entered upon Al-Muqawqis, king of Egypt and Alexandria, king of the Christians, he brought He has images of the prophets, and He produced for him the image of our Prophet - may God bless him and grant him peace - and he recognized it.
And the third aspect:

The same telling him that in the Qur’an time after time, citing the People of the Book and telling him that it is mentioned in their books, Which indicates to the rational person that he was present in their books, because there is no doubt among everyone who knew the condition of Muhammad, whether a believer or an unbeliever, that he was one of The wisest of the people of the earth, those who deny him have no doubt that he had the experience, knowledge and intelligence, which necessitated that He would do such a great thing, the like of which had never happened to anyone, neither before him nor after him, so he knew it was necessary that he would not do it nor would He tells it, and he is one of the most keen people to believe him, and he tells them the ways in which he is believed, and he keeps them away from doing what he knows. He is being lied to.

If he had not known that it was written down among them - but had known that it was not - he would have refrained from telling it time after time, and citing it as evidence. He shows this to those who agree with him and those who oppose him, his friends and his enemies, for this is what no one does except those who are the least rational among people. Because it shows his lie to those of them who believe in him, to those who tell him, and it is the opposite of what he intended and he is in the same position as someone who wants Establishing witnesses to his truth, so he comes to someone who he knows is not lying, and he knows that he is neither a witness nor present in his case, and he says:

This one bears witness of me, and this one bears witness to me, for they were present in this case, and those say: We do not bear witness to him, nor were we present in this matter. The issue is, this would not be done by any rational person who knows that they were not present, that they deny him, and do not bear witness to him.

Fourth: That it be said: When the media established his truthfulness, he informed that it was written in the previous books, and that the prophets had given good tidings of it. It is known that this is the case. But this is not mentioned until separate evidence of his prophecy is established.
The first path is the one who presents the proofs to the People of the Book and demonstrates the signs of his prophecy.

More than one of the scholars has extracted multiple places from the books that are now in the hands of the People of the Book of the glad tidings of his prophecy. They wrote books about that, and these good news in these books are of the same type as the good news about Christ - may God bless him and grant him peace.

The Jews acknowledge the word, but they claim that the one being given good tidings is not the Messiah, Jesus, son of Mary, but rather someone else waiting, and they - in The truth is that they are only waiting for the Antichrist, and they are also waiting for the coming of the Messiah, Jesus, son of Mary, when he descends from heaven, as was revealed in Another place, and they distort the meaning of the word, and say: It does not refer to an awaited prophet, as they said in his saying: “I will raise up for the children of Israel One of their brothers is like you, O Moses. I will send down to him the likes of the Torah of Moses. I will put My words in his mouth.”
Some of them said: This is not news, but rather this is a question of denial, and they estimated a thousand questions, and there is nothing in the text of that.

The Jews distort the meanings that herald the Messiah, and according to Muslims and Christians, this does not discredit the herald of the Messiah, but rather it becomes clear. The significance of the texts on it, and the invalidity of the Jewish distortion.

The same goes for the glad tidings of Muhammad - may God bless him and grant him peace - in the previous books, in which there is no blame for distorting the People of the Book, the Jews. And the Christians. Indeed, the evidence of these texts on the prophecy of Muhammad - may God bless him and grant him peace - and the invalidity of the distortion of the People of the Book became clear.

The fifth aspect: To say: It is known that the emergence of the religion of Muhammad - may God bless him and grant him peace - in the east and west of the earth, is the greatest event that has ever occurred. On earth; No religion has ever been known to have spread and lasted as long as it has.

Even if it was the law of Moses, even if it lasted, its spread and continuity did not spread. Rather, the purpose of its appearance was in some part of the Levant. As for the law of Christ, it was accepted. Constantine did not have a king. Rather, they lived in some Roman countries and elsewhere, and they were weak, and their notables or common people would be killed. Many times, when it spread, its people dispersed into different groups, declaring one another to be infidels.

Then the law of Muhammad - may God bless him and grant him peace - appeared in the east and west of the earth and in the middle of the inhabited earth. The third, fourth, and fifth region, and his nation prevailed over the Christians in the best and most honorable land among them; Like the land of the Levant, Egypt, the Peninsula, and others, and his law lasted, so today he is more than seven hundred years old.

It is known that this claimant to prophecy, whether he is truthful or a liar, must be told by the prophets, for they told With the appearance of the lying Antichrist, as a warning to the people, even though the Antichrist will last only a short period. If what the liar says to Muhammad is true and that he is a liar, He is not a messenger. His temptation would be greater than the temptation of the Antichrist in many ways. Because those who followed him are many times greater than those who follow the Antichrist.

If he were a liar, then those who were tempted by him would be many times as numerous as those who are tempted by the Antichrist, so being warned by him would be better than being warned by the Antichrist. Since there has not been in the world from the time of Adam until today a liar who has appeared and this appearance has continued and continues, so how could the prophets ignore the warning about such as Is this even a lie? .
And if he is truthful: then the good news of belief in him is the first thing that future prophets herald and inform about.

So he knew that it must be mentioned in the books, and then he found many places in the books, more than a hundred places, that used them as evidence for It is mentioned, and it was reported on the authority of many of the People of the Book that it was present in their books, and it was reported on the authority of many of those who converted to Islam that it was The reason for their Islam - or one of the greatest reasons for their Islam - was their knowledge of it being mentioned in previous books, or because it was mentioned in The Books, as is the case with many of those who converted to Islam in ancient and modern times, or because of what was proven to them from the narrations of the People of the Book, such as the Ansar, for he was one of The greatest reasons

Their conversion to Islam was what they used to hear from their neighbors, the People of the Book, in terms of mentioning it and describing it, and their waiting for it, and that among their choices were those It was not obligatory for him to reside in the land of Yathrib despite its hardship and leave the land of Syria with its prosperity, except for his waiting for this Arab prophet who would be sent From the descendants of Ishmael.

It has never been possible for anyone to quote from any book in which he found mention of it with condemnation, denial, and warning, just as there is mention of it. Antichrist. And among the People of the Book, from the mention of its Companions; Such as Omar ibn al-Khattab and others, and their justice and conduct, on the authority of Christ and others, is not known to them. So, if those who extracted his mention from the books of the People of the Book and those who heard information about him from the scholars of the People of the Book only mentioned his description In it, with praise and praise, it is known that the previous prophets mentioned him with praise and praise, and did not mention him with blame or shame.

And everyone who claimed prophethood and who was praised and praised by the prophets was only truthful in his claim of prophethood, since it is impossible that the prophets They praise those who lie in the claim of prophethood: “And who is more unjust than he who invents a lie about God or says, ‘I have been revealed,’ but nothing has been revealed to him.” [Al-An’am: 93] .

This is what shows that the prophets must have mentioned him and told about him, and that they did not mention him except with praise and praise. Not with blame or shame, and that - with the claim of prophethood - does not happen unless he is truthful in the claim of prophethood, and it becomes clear that they were given good tidings. Through his prophecy, and this is what is desired.

This shows that the prophets informed the People of the Book of the events that would happen to them, and of the kings who would rule over them. They kill them, destroy their countries, and take them captive, such as - (Bukhatnasr) and (Singarib), but these kings did not claim that they Prophets, and they did not call to a religion, so the prophets did not need to warn against following them, and they warned against following those who claim prophethood. And he is a liar.

And Muhammad - may God bless him and grant him peace - had subjugated the People of the Book, killed whomever he killed and captured whomever he had taken captive, and expelled them from their homes, so it was necessary They remember him and remember the events that happened to them in his days. If he is a liar and claims to be a prophet, then he must warn them against following him, and it is known that most of the People of the Book and those who transmitted from them Either he says: It is not found in our books, or he says: It is found with praise and praise. No one can quote from the books. The previous one is that it is mentioned in terms of condemnation and warning.

If he had been mentioned by them with condemnation and warnings, it would have been one of the greatest arguments they could use against him during his lifetime, and against his nation after his death. Those who did not convert to Islam use it as evidence against those who did.

It is known that many of the People of the Book had hatred for him, enmity, and denial of him, and were keen to nullify him. His command, which did not necessitate them inventing things that did not exist, and attributing to Him things that everyone who knew about him knew to be false, until the matter was resolved. with each other until they interpreted the Muslims’ saying “Allahu Akbar” to mean that “the greatest” is an idol, and that the Prophet commanded them to venerate this idol. Some of them said about it: It makes adultery obligatory for a woman who has been divorced three times. As a punishment for her husband, not allowing him to marry her until someone else commits adultery with her. Some of them said:

He learned from Buhaira the monk, despite the fact that everyone who knew his biography knew that he did not meet Buhaira alone, and only saw him for part of the day with him. His companions, when they passed by him when they came to the Levant in trade, and that (Buhaira) asked them about him and did not speak to him except a few words in which he would tell him about His condition.
He didn't tell him anything.

Although some of the People of the Book criticized him for saying that he was sent by the sword, they might even say: His religion was established only by the sword, and so that they might make people believe that those who They followed him but they followed him out of fear of the sword, and they even say: The preacher only leans on the sword on Friday, indicating that he is only standing Religion by the sword, to matters like these - which are among the most obvious matters - a lie to him - even the least person with knowledge of his condition knows that it is a lie, And yet they cling to it.

If they had had information about the prophets that necessitated criticizing him and warning against following him, they would have demonstrated that and used it as evidence. Stronger and more eloquent, and this was something that should usually be known among their elite and the common people, ancient and modern, and this was the appearance It is more likely that the news of the Antichrist will appear among them and among the Muslims. This matter is one of the greatest concerns and reasons available for conveying and spreading it.

If this is not the case, then it is known that there is nothing in the books of the prophets that would necessitate denying it, and the evidence has been established that it is necessary The prophets remember him and inform him of his condition, so if they do not inform him that he is a liar, it is known that they were informed that he is a truthful prophet, as is rumored. It appeared and expanded in many ways.

The book with which he was sent is full of written testimony to him, and the books found in them contain many places that bear witness to him in many ways. Multiple, and there are frequent reports about someone who converted to Islam for that reason, and this is what necessitates it being certain that it is mentioned in it in a way that indicates his truthfulness in The claim of prophethood, and there is nothing in it that indicates his lie or warns against him, and this is what is required.

In short, his matter is more apparent, more famous, more astonishing, more dazzling, and more unusual than any human matter that has ever appeared in the world. And if such a person is a liar, then his lie has very many concomitants that go beyond counting, advanced, comparative, and posterior. If someone has a lesser claim than him, if he is a liar, then his lie must be one of the necessities that makes his lie clear, so how is something like this? ! If the requirements for a lie are not present, then the binding element is not present.

Its truthfulness is necessary for many things, all of which indicate its truthfulness, and the proof of the necessary thing requires the confirmation of the necessary thing, its past, its comparisons, and its past. The one who claims prophethood is not devoid of truthfulness or lying, and both truthfulness and lying have requirements and requirements, so evidence of truthfulness is necessary for him. The evidence of lying is necessary for it, and truthfulness is necessary for it, and lying is necessary for it, so its truthfulness is known in two types:

By proving the evidence of truthfulness that necessitates his sincerity, and by the absence of the requisites for lying whose absence necessitates the absence of his lying, just as he lied A liar is known by the evidence of his lying that necessitates his lying, and by the absence of the necessities of truthfulness, the absence of which necessitates the absence of his honesty. And God knows best.

A thing is sometimes known by what indicates its stability, and sometimes by what indicates the absence of its opposite, which is what is called the analogy of succession, for if a thing It was limited to two things, the proof of one of them required the absence of the other, and from the absence of one of them the other was proven. The one who claims prophethood is either truthful or a liar, and each of them has requisites whose absence indicates its absence, and each of them has requisites whose validity indicates its absence. On its stability.

The evidence of a thing is necessary for it, such as the signs and evidence of prophecy, the signs of divinity, the evidence of rulings, and so on, and the absence of the thing. He knows what necessitates its negation, such as the absence of its necessities; Like the truthfulness of a liar, it is said: If he were truthful, he would be characterized by what truthful people are characterized by.

Likewise, when a truthful person lies, it is said: If he were a liar, he would be characterized by what a liar is characterized by, for he knew the condition of the truthful prophets. And the prophets are liars. The absence of what is necessary for a lie is evidence of its truthfulness, just as the confirmation of what is required for truthfulness is evidence of its truthfulness. A liar is proven to be lying by what necessitates his lying and by the absence of the necessities of his truthfulness, and so on for all other matters.

chapters.title: Detailing the testimonies of the previous books of Muhammad, peace and blessings be upon him, and examples of them
paragraphs: [Chapter: Testimonies of the previous books of Muhammad, peace and blessings be upon him, and examples thereof]

Chapter: What must be known is what we have been alerted to more than once, that the testimony of the previous books of Muhammad - may God bless him and grant him peace - is either Her testimony of his prophecy, or her testimony of what he told of the clear signs of his prophecy and the prophecy of those before him, It is an argument against the People of the Book and against non-People of the Book from the types of atheist polytheists, as God has mentioned this type of verses. In other places in his book.
As in the Almighty’s saying: “Have there not been a sign for them that the scholars of the Children of Israel should have taught it?” [Al-Shu’ara: 197]...
And He said: {If you are in doubt about what We have revealed to you, then ask those who read the Book before you} [Yunus: 94].
And His saying: {Say: Allah is sufficient as a witness between me and you and whoever has knowledge of the Scripture} [Al-Ra’ad: 43].
And His saying: {Those to whom We have given the Book know it as they know their own children} [Al-Baqarah: 146].

And he said: {And when they hear what was revealed to the Messenger, you will see their eyes overflowing with tears because of the truth they have recognized. They say, “Our Lord, we believe, so write with Witnesses, and what do we have? We do not believe in God and in the truth that has come to us, and we hope that our Lord will admit us with the righteous people.} [Al-Maeda: 83].

And His saying: {Indeed, those who were given knowledge before it, when it is recited to them, bow down to the chins in prostration and say, Glory be to our Lord, if the promise of our Lord is fulfilled. And they bow down to their chins, weeping, and their humility increases} [Al-Isra: 107].

This is like his saying in the Torah, which was translated in Arabic: “God came from Mount Sinai.” And some of them say: “God appeared from Mount Sinai.” And it rose from Seir, and it rose from the mountains of Paran.”

Many scholars said - and the wording is by Abu Muhammad bin Qutaybah - that this is neither hidden nor ambiguous for anyone who ponders it; Because the coming of God from Mount Sinai: His revelation of the Torah to Moses from Mount Sinai, as it is with the People of the Book, and with us, and so it must be. That its sunrise would be from Seir when the Gospel was revealed to Christ, and Christ was from Seir - the land of Hebron in a village called (Nazareth) - And by its name, those who follow it are called Christians.

Just as its rising from Seir must have been through Christ, so its revelation must have been from the mountains of Paran: His revelation of the Qur’an. Ali Muhammad - may God bless him and grant him peace - and the mountains of Paran are the mountains of Mecca. He said: There is no disagreement between Muslims and the People of the Book regarding the fact that Paran is Mecca. If they claim that it is not Mecca, then no one can deny that. Twist them and undo them.
We said: Is it not in the Torah that Abraham lived (Hagar) and (Ishmael) in two cities? .
And we said: Show us the place from which God was revealed, and its name is Paran, and the Prophet who sent down a book to it after the Messiah, was not (he was revealed) And (publicly)
They mean the same thing? This is what appeared and was revealed.
Do you know of a religion that appeared with the advent of Islam and spread throughout the east and west of the earth and was distorted? .

Ibn Zafar said: (Seir) is a mountain in the Levant, from which the prophecy of the Messiah appeared. I said: Next to Bethlehem, the village in which Christ was born is a village called to this day Seir, and it has a mountain called Seir.
And in the Torah: The descendants of Ez were residents of Seir, and God commanded Moses not to harm them.

Based on this, the mention of the three mountains is correct, Mount Hira, which is not a higher mountain around Mecca, and from it was the first descent. The revelation to the Prophet - may God bless him and grant him peace - and around him were many mountains, to the point that it was said: In Mecca there are twelve thousand mountains. That place is called Paran, to this day, and in it was the beginning of the revelation of the Qur’an.

The wilderness between Mecca and Mount Sinai is called the Desert of Paran, and no one can claim that - after Christ - a book was revealed about any of that. the earth, and no prophet has been sent. Then it was known that what was meant by its rising from the mountains of Paran was nothing but the sending of Muhammad - may God bless him and grant him peace - and he - glory be to Him - mentioned this in The Torah in chronological order. So he mentioned the revelation of the Torah, then the Gospel, then the Qur’an, and these books are God’s light and guidance.

He said in the first: He came, or: He appeared, in the second: He shone, and in the third: He was revealed. The coming of the Torah was like the rising of the dawn, or something clearer than that, and the descent of the Gospel was like the rising of the sun, and the light was increased by it. And guidance.

As for the revelation of the Qur’an, it is like the appearance of the sun in the sky. That is why he said: And it was revealed from the mountains of Paran, for the Prophet - may God bless him and grant him peace - through him God’s light and guidance appeared in the east of the earth. And its setting is greater than what was revealed in the two previous books, just as the light of the sun appears when it rises in the easts and wests of the earth; That is why God called it a shining lamp, and He called the sun a radiant lamp.

Creation has a greater need for an illuminating lamp than a blazing lamp. For the glowing light they need at a certain time, and as it was said: they may be affected by it some of the time, but as for the luminous lamp they need To Him at all times and in every place, day and night, secretly and publicly.
The Prophet - may God bless him and grant him peace - said: “The earth, its easts and its wests, have been planted for me, and the dominion of my nation will reach what has been planted for me.”

And these are the three places that God swore by in the Qur’an in the Almighty’s saying: {And the fig and the olive and Mount Sinai. And this is a trustworthy city. We created man in the best of standing, then We returned him to the lowest level, in disgrace. Except for those who believe and do righteous deeds, for them is a reward beyond measure. So what would deny you? After religion, is not God the wisest of judges?} [Al-Tin: 1].

So he swore by the figs and the olives, which is the holy land in which these things grow, and from them the Messiah was resurrected, and the Gospel was revealed to him therein. And he swore by Mount Sinin, which is the mountain where God spoke to Moses and called him from its right valley, from the blessed spot of the tree, and he swore In the safe land, which is Mecca, and it is the land in which Abraham, his son Ishmael, and his mother resided, and it is the city that God made a safe sanctuary, and it is to be kidnapped. The people around them, in terms of creation and matter, predestination and Sharia, so Abraham forbade it and prayed for its people and said:

{Our Lord, I have settled some of my descendants in a valley devoid of crops near Your Sacred House. Our Lord, that they may establish prayer, so make the hearts of the people to them and provide them with fruits that they may be grateful.” [Ibrahim: 37].

And God Almighty said: {And when We made the House a place of rest for the people and a place of safety, and they took the place of Abraham as a place of prayer, and We covenanted with Abraham and Ishmael that Purify My House for those who circle around and seclude themselves and those who kneel and prostrate. And when Abraham said, “My Lord, make this a secure land and provide its people with fruits - whoever believes.” “And whoever disbelieves, I will give him enjoyment for a little, then I will force him to the torment of the Fire, and wretched is the destination” [Al-Baqarah: 125].

So God Almighty told that Abraham called upon God to make Mecca a safe city, and God answered Abraham’s supplication, and He mentioned that in other than A place, and with it Abraham built the House, as God Almighty said:

{And when Abraham raised the foundations of the House and Ishmael, “Our Lord, accept from us. Indeed, You are the Hearer, the Knowing. Our Lord, and make us submit to You and those who Our descendants are a nation submissive to you, and show us our rites, and accept our repentance. Indeed, you are the Forgiving, the Most Merciful. Our Lord, and send among them a messenger from among themselves, who will recite to them Your revelations, and teach them the Book and the wisdom, and purify them. Indeed, it is You, the Mighty, the Wise.} [Al-Baqarah: 127].

And He Almighty said: {Indeed, the first House established for mankind was the one in Mecca; blessed and a guidance for the worlds. In it are clear signs, the station of Abraham, and whoever enters it will be We are safe, and for God is the duty of the people. The pilgrimage to the House is whoever is able to make a way to it, and whoever disbelieves, then surely God is Self-sufficient of the worlds.” [Al-Imran: 96].

And God Almighty said: “For the Quraysh to acquaint themselves with the journey of winter and summer, let them worship the Lord of this House, who has fed them from hunger and protected them from Fear} [Quraysh: 1].

And He, the Most High, said: {And they said, “If we follow guidance with you, we will be snatched from our land. Have we not established for them a secure sanctuary to which are brought the fruits of all things as a provision?” from Us, but most of them do not know” [Al-Qasas: 57].

And God Almighty said: {Have they not seen that We have made a secure sanctuary and people are being kidnapped around them? Do they then believe in falsehood and disbelieve in the grace of God?} [Al-Ankabut: 67].
So God Almighty says: {By the fig and the olive and Mount Sinai and this trustworthy land} [Al-Tin: 1].

Part of it is in the three honorable and venerable places, in which His light and guidance appeared, and in which the three were revealed: the Torah and the Gospel. And the Qur’an. He also mentioned the three in the Torah by saying: “God came from Mount Sinai, rose from Seir, and was revealed from the mountains of Paran.”

Since what was in the Torah was news about it, it was told about it in its chronological order, so He presented the first to the first. As for the Qur’an, it swore by it, glorifying its status, and that is glorifying His power - Glory be to Him - and His signs, and His books, and His messengers. So he swore by it gradually, degree by degree, and concluded it with the highest degree. So he swore first by the figs and olives, then by Mount Sinai, then by Mecca, because the three most honorable books were: the Qur’an, then the Torah, then the Gospel. Likewise the prophets, so he swore by it gradually, as in his saying:.

{And the progeny [women] are abundant in length, then those who bear [the] protection, [so] the [female] [women] [women] are ease, [so] [the] [women] who divide [the creatures] [are] [in] ease.} [Al-Dhariyat: 1]

So he swore by the layers of creatures, layer after layer. He swore by the winds that spread, then by the clouds that carry rain, for they are above The winds, then the flowing ones, ease, and it has been said: they are the ships. But it is more appropriate that they be the stars mentioned in his saying: {So I do not swear by the khuns - the sweeping stars} [Al-Takwir: 15-16].
So he called them Jawāri, just as the astronomy called Jawāri in His saying: “And among His signs are the Jawār in the sea like flags” [Al-Shura: 32].
And the planets are above the clouds.
Then he said: {The things that are divided are a matter} [Al-Dhariyat: 4].
These are the angels that are higher in status than all of this.

And what Ibn Qutaybah and other Muslim scholars mentioned about Ishmael’s upbringing in the wilderness of Paran, this is how he is in the Torah. He said In it: (And in the morning Abraham took the lad, and took bread and a drink of water, and gave them to Hagar, and carried them upon her, and said to her: Go, So Hagar departed, and became lost in the Desert of Sheba, and the water that was with her ran out, so she threw the boy under a tree, and sat opposite him on the The size of an arrow shot, so that she would not see the boy when he died. And she raised her voice in weeping, and God heard the voice of the boy, so the King of God called Hagar. And he said to her:

What is the matter with you, Hajar, do not be afraid; For God has heard the voice of the boy where he is, so arise, carry the boy and hold him tight in your hand, for I will assign him to a great nation, and God has granted victory. Her eyes saw a well of water, and she drew the lad and filled her waterskins. And God was with the lad, and he grew up and dwelt in the Desert of Paran.

This is the news of God in the Torah: that Ishmael was raised and lived in the Paran Desert after he nearly died of thirst, and that God gave him drink of A water well. It was known through transmission, and the consensus of the nations, that Ishmael was raised in Mecca, and he and his father Abraham built the House. So it was known that the land Mecca, Paran.

And this is the good news in the Torah to Hagar about Ishmael, and God’s saying: “Indeed, I will make him a great nation, very venerated, and Hagar She opened her eyes and saw a well of water, so she approached it - to the end of the words.
In another place, he said about Ishmael: “He places his hand above the hands of all.”
It is known, by international agreement and transmission, that Ishmael was raised in the land of Mecca.

So he learned that it was “Paran,” and that he and Abraham had built the house that was still preserved from the time of Abraham. Arabs and non-Arabs would perform Hajj there. Among the prophets and others, as Musa bin Imran and Yunus bin Matta made a pilgrimage to him, as in the authentic narration of Ibn Abbas, “The Messenger of God - May God’s prayers and peace be upon him - he passed by Wadi Al-Azraq and said: What valley is this? They said: This is Wadi Al-Azraq. He said:

It is as if I am looking at Moses - may God’s prayers and peace be upon him - descending from the place, placing his fingers in his ears, with an attitude towards God - the Almighty - the Majestic. By reciting the talbiyah, passing through this valley. He said: Then we walked until we came to a second place. He said: What second place is this? They said: Harsha, and he said: It is as if I were looking at Yunus on a red she-camel, wearing a wool cloak, and the muzzle of his she-camel was covered with fur, passing through this valley. “Fulfilling the answer.”
And in a narration: “As for Moses, he was the man of Adam, sitting on a red camel with a muzzle.”

And when God sent Muhammad - may God bless him and grant him peace - he made it obligatory for everyone to perform Hajj, so nations from the east and west of the earth made the pilgrimage to him. The well from which Ishmael and his mother drank is the Well of Zamzam, and its hadith is mentioned in Sahih al-Bukhari, on the authority of Ibn Abbas, who said: The first time women used logic was before Ishmael’s mother. She used logic to relieve her effect on Sarah.
Then Abraham brought her and her son Ishmael, and she breastfed him until he placed her at the House, at a pool above Zamzam, at the top of The mosque is not in Mecca.

On that day, there was no water, and there was no water in it. He placed by her a jug containing dates and a waterskin containing water. Then Abraham stood up and set off, and his mother followed him. Ismail, and she said: O Ibrahim, where are you going and leaving us in this valley with no people or anything in it? She said that to him repeatedly, but he did not pay attention to her. She said to him: Did God command you to do this? He said: Yes, she said: Then he will not waste us. Then it returned, and Abraham set off until, when he was at the place where they could not see him, he faced the House with his face, then he made these supplications and said:
{Our Lord, I have settled some of my descendants in a valley devoid of crops near Your Sacred House} [Ibrahim: 37] until it reached “they give thanks.”

And Ishmael’s mother breastfed Ishmael and drank from that water until the waterskin ran out and she became thirsty and her son thirsted, and she made She looked at him writhing. She started out, hating to look at him, and found Al-Safa the closest mountain on earth next to her, so she stood on it and then faced... You look into the valley, do you see anyone? She did not see anyone, so she descended from Al-Safa, until when she reached the valley, she raised the edge of her shield and then continued with the effort of a human being, until she passed. Then she came to the valley, so she stood up and looked to see if she could see anyone? She did not see anyone, so she did that seven times.

Ibn Abbas said: The Prophet - may God bless him and grant him peace - said: That is why the people ran between them, and when Marwa approached, she heard a voice, so she said: “Shh.” She wants herself - so she heard - also - and said: You have heard, if you have Ghaywath, then behold, she is with the angel at the place of Zamzam, so search With his heel - or he said: with his wing - until the water appeared, so she surrounded it and said thus with her hand, scooping some of the water into her watering can, and it boiled over. After you scoop. Ibn Abbas said: The Prophet - may God bless him and grant him peace - said:
May God have mercy on Umm Ismail. If she had left Zamzam without scooping some of the water, it would have been a spring.

He said: So she drank and breastfed her child, and the king said to her: Do not be afraid of the village; For here is the house of God, which this boy and his father are building, and God does not waste its people. The house was raised from the ground like a hill, and the floods came and took it from its right and left, and he mentioned the entirety of the hadith.

The well of Zamzam had been damaged, then Abdul Muttalib, the grandfather of the Prophet - may God bless him and grant him peace - revived it, and watering became in his son: in Al-Abbas. And his children drink from it, and they also give him sweet drink, and drinking from that is Sunnah.

And God - the Almighty - said about Ishmael: “Indeed, I will make him into a great and very great nation.” This glorification, which is confirmed by - (very, very), requires that it be an exaggerated glorification. If it were assumed that no one would make Hajj to the house that he built, and that his descendants did not have a prophet among them, as many of the People of the Book say, then he would not There is a very, very exaggerated exaggeration; The most important thing in this is that he has offspring. The mere fact that a man has descendants and descendants does not make him great unless there are believers and obedient people among the offspring.

Likewise his saying: “I will make him a great nation.” If that nation was an infidel, it would not be great. Rather, he was the father of an infidel nation. So he knew that this great nation were believers, and these people performed Hajj to the Kaaba, so he knew that Hajj to the Kaaba is something that God loves and commands.

And there is no one among the People of the Book to make Hajj except Muslims, so it is known that they are the ones who did what God loves and is pleased with, and that they and their predecessors were the ones who They used to perform Hajj to the Kaaba, a nation that God praised and honored, and that Ishmael was greatly venerated by God, for the faith he imbued in his descendants. And prophecy, and this is just as God expressed gratitude to Noah and Abraham by saying:
{And We sent Noah and Abraham and placed in their descendants prophecy and the Book} [Al-Hadid: 26].
And he said in Hebron: {And We placed among his descendants prophecy and the Book} [Al-Ankabut: 27].

Thus it was known that Ishmael and his descendants are venerated and praised by God, and that Ishmael is venerated very, very much, just as God venerated Noah and Abraham. Even if Abraham was better than Ishmael, the point is that this veneration for him and his descendants only occurs if his descendants follow the religion. Indeed, these people make the pilgrimage to this house, and no one else will make the pilgrimage to it after the coming of Muhammad.
For this reason, when God Almighty said: {And for God is the duty of the people to perform the Hajj to the House} [Al Imran: 97].
They said: We will not perform Hajj. He said: {And whoever disbelieves, then surely Allah is Self-sufficient of the worlds} [Al-Imran: 97].
And - also - this exaggerated exaltation, by which the son of Ishmael became above the people, did not appear except with the prophecy of Muhammad, so this indicates that It is true and promised.

This is the description of Muhammad - may God bless him and grant him peace - not the description of the Messiah, for he was the one who was sent with a strong law, and he defeated the kings and nations of the earth, until The earth is filled with him and his nation from the east and west of the earth, and his authority is permanent and no one has been able to remove it, just as the kingdom of The Jews and the rule of the Christians ceased to exist in the best parts of the earth and its middle areas.

Similar to this is another glad tidings about Muhammad - may God bless him and grant him peace - from the words of “Simon” according to what they pleased with their translation, which is: “God has come With clear proofs from the mountains of Paran, and the heavens and the earth were filled with his praise and the praise of his nation.”

This is a statement of the prophecy of Muhammad - may God bless him and grant him peace - who brought the prophecy from the mountains of Paran, and the heavens and the earth were filled with His praise and the praise of his nation.

And no one ever left, and the heavens and the earth were filled with his praise and the praise of his nation, with what is called “Paraan” except Muhammad - may God’s prayers and peace be upon him. And he greeted - and the Messiah was not in the land of Paran at all. And Moses only spoke from Al-Tur, and Al-Tur was not from the land of Paran, and if the wilderness between Al-Tur and the land of Hijaz was from Paran, then God did not descend. In it is the Torah, and the good tidings of the Torah were presented at Mount Tur, and the good tidings of the Gospel were presented at Mount Seir.

And similar to this, as was reported in the prophecy of Habakkuk, that he said: God came from the South, and the Holy Place appeared on the mountains of Paran, and the land was filled with Praise be to Him (Ahmed) and with his right hand he ruled over the nations, and the earth was illuminated by his light and his horses were carried on the sea.

And from that is what is in the Torah that is in their hands, in the first book of it, which is five books, in the ninth chapter in the story of Hagar, when she departed from Sarah and the king spoke to her and said: “O Hagar, where did you come from? And where do you want to go?” When she explained the situation to him, he said: Go back, for I will increase Your offspring and your crops until they are innumerable, and here you are, conceiving and giving birth to a son, and we will name him Ishmael. For God has heard your humiliation and your submission, and your son will be a tyrant of people, and his hand will be above all, and the hand of all will be through him, and he will be on the borders of All his brothers.
He said: Those who extracted this good news:

It is known that the hand of the Bani Ishmael before the sending of Muhammad - may God bless him and grant him peace - was not above the hands of the Bani Ishaq, but rather it was among the Bani Ishaq. Prophecy and the Book, and they entered Egypt at the time of Joseph with Jacob, and the children of Ishmael had no power over them, then they left it when he was sent Moses, and they were with Moses the mightiest of the people of the earth, and no one had a hand over them. Then with (Joshua) after him until the time of David, and the reign of Solomon, who did not Someone like him was given authority over them after that (Bukhatnasr), but the children of Ishmael had no hand over them. Then the Messiah was sent and the house was destroyed. The sanctuary is the second desolation, where they corrupted the land twice, and from then on their kingdom ceased, and God divided them into nations into the earth, and they were under The rule of the Romans and the Persians. The Arabs did not have greater authority over them than others. The son of Ishmael did not have authority over any of the nations - No. People of the Book, nor the illiterate - so the hand of the son of Ishmael was not above all of them, until God sent Muhammad; What Abraham and Ishmael called for when they said:

{Our Lord, and raise among them a messenger from among themselves who will recite to them Your verses, and teach them the Book and wisdom, and purify them. Indeed, it is You, the Mighty, the Wise.} [Al-Baqarah: 129].

When he was sent, the hand of Ishmael’s son was above all, and there was no sultan on earth more powerful than theirs, and they subdued Persia, the Romans, and others. From the nations, and they subjugated the Jews, Christians, Magians, polytheists, and Sabians. Thus appeared the fulfillment of what he said in the Torah, “And his hand will be above all, and the hand of all will be through him,” and this is a matter that will continue until the end of time.

If it is said: This is good news of his rule and appearance? It was said: Kingship has two kings; A kingdom in which there is no claim to prophethood, and this was not the case for the children of Ishmael in general, and a kingdom that was issued by the claim of prophethood. A liar: “And who is more unjust than he who invents a lie against God or says, ‘It has been revealed to me,’ but nothing has been revealed to him.” [Al-An’am: 93].

This is one of the worst of people, the most lying, the most unjust, and the most ungodly, and his kingdom is worse than the kingdom of the oppressor who did not claim prophethood, like - (Bukhtasir) and (Singareeb).

It is known that the news of this is not good news, and Sarah and Abraham are not happy about this, as if it had been said: He will be a tyrant and a tyrant who will conquer. people to obey him, and he kills them and takes their harems captive, and takes their wealth unjustly. “For informing of this is neither good news nor The informer is pleased with that, but it is good news that pleases him, if that is just, and his elevation is praiseworthy and there is no sin in it, and that is in the one who claims There is no prophecy unless he is truthful and not a liar.”

chapters.title: Separating Bishara from the Psalms and its interpretation
paragraphs: [Chapter: Good news from the Psalms and its interpretation]

Chapter and he said: David in the Psalms in his saying: “Glorify God with a new glorification, and let him rejoice in the Creator for whom God has chosen his nation and given him victory, and rewarded the righteous among them with honor. They glorified it on their beds and glorified God with loud voices, with sharpened swords in their hands. two blades, to take vengeance with them on the nations who do not worship him.”

These attributes only apply to the attributes of Muhammad - may God bless him and grant him peace - and his nation, for they are the ones who glorify God with loud voices in their hearts. Their call to prayer for the five daily prayers, and on high places, as Jabir bin Abdullah said: (“We were with the Messenger of God - may God bless him and grant him peace - when... When we ascended, we said “Allahu Akbar,” and when we descended, “Allahu Akbar,” and the prayer was prescribed for that.”) Narrated by Abu Dawud and others, and in the two Sahihs on the authority of Ibn Umar. He said:

“Whenever the Messenger of God - may God bless him and grant him peace - departed from armies or companies or for Hajj or Umrah, he would pay his debt in a group or as a delegate. He said “Allahu Akbar” three times, then said: “There is no god but God alone, with no partner. To Him belongs dominion and to Him is praise, and He is capable of all things. They are repentant, worshipers.” Prostrating to our Lord, praising God. God has fulfilled His promise and supported His servant and defeated the parties alone.”

And in Sahih Al-Bukhari on the authority of Anas, he said: “The Messenger of God - may God bless him and grant him peace - prayed while we were with him in Medina. The noon prayer was four, and the afternoon prayer was He performed two rak'ahs, then spent the night with it until morning, then he rode until his camel came to rest with him on al-Bayda. He thanked God, glorified God, and glorified God, then he made the decree. “By Umrah and Hajj,” and he mentioned the hadith.

On the authority of Abu Hurairah: “A man said: O Messenger of God, I want to travel, so advise me.” He said: You must fear God and say “Allahu Akbar” with every honor. When the man left, he said: O God, lengthen the distance for him, and make the journey easy for him.” Narrated by Imam Ahmad, Al-Tirmidhi and Al-Nasa’i.

Ibn Majah narrated from him: “I advise you to fear God and exalt God with all honor.” Abu Dawud and others narrated with an authentic chain of transmission on the authority of Ibn Umar. On the authority of the Prophet - may God bless him and grant him peace - he said: “When the Prophet - may God bless him and grant him peace - and his armies ascended, they would glorify God, and when they descended, they would glorify God.”

They glorify God with loud, raised voices during their festivals: Eid al-Fitr and Eid al-Sacrifice, during prayer and sermon, and when they go to... Prayer and during the days of (Mina) the pilgrims, and the rest of the people of Egypt, say “Allahu Akbar” after the prayers, so it is Sunnah for the imam of prayer to pronounce “Allahu Akbar” loudly.

Al-Bukhari mentioned on the authority of Omar ibn al-Khattab: He used to say “Allahu Akbar” in Mina, and the people of the mosque would hear him and say “Allahu Akbar” with his words, and he would hear them. The people of the markets would say “Allahu Akbar” until Mina would say “Allahu Akbar.”

Ibn Omar and Ibn Abbas used to go out to the market on the ten days and say “Allahu Akbar” and the people would say “Allahu Akbar” by saying “Allahu Akbar” to them, and they would say “Allahu Akbar” over their offerings. And their sacrifices and their sacrifices, just as “their Prophet used to say when slaughtering: In the name of God and God is great,” and they said “Allahu Akbar” when they stoned the Jamarat. They say “Allahu Akbar” on Safa and Marwah, and they pronounce “Allahu Akbar” during Tawaf when rounding the corner, and in all of this they say “Allahu Akbar” aloud, other than what they say quietly.
He - the Almighty - said, when he mentioned the fast of Ramadan, for which they celebrate Eid al-Fitr. He has guided you, and perhaps you will be grateful.} [Al-Baqarah: 185].

And when he mentioned the sacrifice that is offered on the Eid of Sacrifice, which is the greatest day of Hajj, he said: {And the body We have made for you among the rituals of God for you in it. It is good, so mention the name of God over it in rows, and when it is ripe on its south side, then eat from it and feed the contented and the freed. Thus We have made it subservient to you. Perhaps you will be grateful. God will not attain their flesh nor their blood, but He will attain piety from you. Likewise, He has subjected them to you so that you may magnify God for what He has guided you and given good news to the doers of good.} [Al-Hajj: 36].

The Christians call the Muslim holiday the “Allahu Akbar” holiday because of the appearance of takbeer in it, and this is not for any of the nations, the People of the Book, or anyone else. - Non-Muslims - Moses only used to gather the children of Israel with the sound of the trumpet, and the Christians used to call the bell.
As for glorifying God with loud voices, it is the ritual of the Muslims, for the call to prayer is the slogan of the Muslims, and this shows negligence. Who explained this by meeting the pilgrims?

And in the two Sahih books, on the authority of Anas, on the authority of the Prophet - may God bless him and grant him peace -: “If he wanted to raid, he would hear the call to prayer or see a mosque. Otherwise he will become jealous.”

And in a Muslim version: “He used to go to prayer when dawn broke, and he used to listen to the call to prayer. If he heard the call to prayer, he would stay fast, otherwise he would go to the call to prayer.”

So he heard a man saying: God is great, God is great, so the Messenger of God - may God bless him and grant him peace - said: On fitrah. Then he said: I bear witness that there is no god but Allah, and he said: I came out of the Fire.

Likewise his saying: “In their hands are double-bladed swords,” which are the Arab swords with which the Companions and their followers conquered the country, and his saying: “They glorify Him on their beds. An explanation of the description of the believers who remember God standing and sitting and on their sides, and one of them prays standing, if not He can, then sitting, and if he is not able, then on his side. They do not neglect the remembrance of God in this situation, but rather they remember Him even in this situation, and they pray in Houses are on beds, unlike the People of the Book.

And prayer is the greatest of glorifications, as in the Almighty’s saying: {So Glory be to God when you arrive in the evening and when you become morning. To Him is praise in the heavens and the earth and in the evening. And when you appear.} [Al-Rum: 17].
And His saying: {And glorify the praise of your Lord before the sun rises and before its setting} [Taha: 130].

And in the two Sahih books, on the authority of Jarir bin Abdullah, he said: “We were sitting with the Messenger of God - may God bless him and grant him peace - when he looked at the moon on the night of the full moon. He said: You will see your Lord as you see this moon, and you will not be troubled about seeing it. If you are able not to miss a prayer before its rising. The sun and a prayer before it sets, so do it. Then he read the Almighty’s saying: {And glorify the praise of your Lord before the rising of the sun and before its setting and from the end of the night so glorify it and at the ends of the day. Perhaps you will be satisfied} [Taha: 130] »

This is the meaning of the words of David: Glorify God with a new glorification, and the glorifications that God has legislated new: such as the five prayers that He has legislated for Muslims. New. When Gabriel established it for the Prophet - may God bless him and grant him peace - he said: “This is your time and the time of the prophets before you.”

So the prophets used to glorify God during these times, as the previous praise indicates, and the new praise, as the rest of the words indicate. This cannot be for Christians; For they do not glorify God with raised voices, nor with double-bladed swords in their hands, that God may avenge them on the nations, but rather their reports. It indicates that they were defeated along with the nations. They did not fight them with the sword. Rather, the Christians might find fault with those who fight the infidels with the sword.

And among them are those who make this one of the faults of Muhammad - may God bless him and grant him peace - and his nation, and they ignore what they have that God commanded Moses to fight The infidels, so the children of Israel fought them according to his command, and Joshua and David and other prophets fought them, and Abraham the Hebron fought to repel them. Injustice against its owners.

chapters.title: Another chapter of glad tidings from the Psalms
paragraphs: [Chapter: Another glad tidings from the Psalms]

Chapter And David said in his Psalms - which are the Psalms -: For this reason God has blessed him forever, so girdle yourself - O mighty one - with the sword; Because splendor is your face, and praise prevails over you. Ride on the word of truth and the mark of deification, for your law and your laws are coupled with the majesty of your right hand, your arrows are sharp, and the nations fall down. It rubs against you.

They said: There is none of the prophets who wields the sword after David except Muhammad - may God bless him and grant him peace - and he is the one under whom the nations fell down and were united. His laws are based on awe, as he - may God bless him and grant him peace - said: “I was supported by terror for a month’s journey.” He told David that he had a law and laws, and addressed him with the word “the mighty,” referring to his strength and his conquest of the enemies of God, in contrast to The oppressed, the oppressed.

He - may God bless him and grant him peace - is a prophet of mercy, and a prophet of epicness. And his nation is harsh toward the unbelievers, merciful toward each other, humble toward the believers, and dear toward the unbelievers. Unlike the one who was submissive to the two groups of Christians who were oppressed with the infidels, or who was dear to the Jewish believers, rather he was arrogant. Whenever a messenger came to them with anything their souls did not desire, they rejected one group and killed another.

chapters.title: Chapter of the third good news from David, peace be upon him
paragraphs: [Chapter: The third good news from David, peace be upon him]

Chapter They said: And David said in his psalm: “Indeed, our Lord is great and greatly to be praised.” And in his translation: “Our God is holy, and Muhammad has spread over the earth.” "It's all joy." They said: David stipulated the name of Muhammad - may God bless him and grant him peace - and his country, and called it the village of God, and told that his word pervades the earth. All of it.

I said: The authentic hadith was preceded by what was said about Abdullah bin Amr, and it was narrated that he was Abdullah bin Salam. “Tell us some of the characteristics of the Messenger of God.” - May God’s prayers and peace be upon him - in the Torah. He said: “Indeed, he is described in the Torah with some of his descriptions in the Qur’an,” and he mentioned that his description is present in The prophecy of Isaiah, and it is not found in the book of Moses itself.
It was previously mentioned that by the word “Torah” they mean the type of books that the People of the Book have, and they do not specifically refer to the Book of Moses.

If this is known to them in the Torah and the Gospel, then what is meant by the Torah is the type of books that the People of the Book have, it deals with that The Book of Moses, the Psalms of David, and the records of all the prophets - except the Gospel - for it is not with the People of the Book, rather it is with the Christians. Especially.

As for the rest of the books of the prophets, both nations acknowledge them, and this is supported by the fact that God often compares the Torah and the Gospel in the Qur’an. And among the Qur’an, the Psalms are only mentioned singly, as God Almighty says: Verifying what was before Him, and sent down the Torah and the Gospel before, as guidance for mankind, and sent down the Criterion} [Al Imran: 1].

And his saying: {Indeed, God has purchased from the believers their lives and their wealth that Paradise will be theirs. They fight in the cause of God, so they kill and are killed. A promise that is true in the Torah, the Gospel, and the Qur’an.} [At-Tawbah: 111].
And God Almighty says: {Which they find written down among them in the Torah and the Gospel} [Al-A’raf: 157].
The People of the Book find it written in the books in their hands, and in many of them it is clearer than it is in the Book of Moses in particular.

If what is meant by the Torah is the type of books, then no rational person would doubt the many mentions of him and his descriptions and the descriptions of his nation in those books, and it is known that God intended by that to cite His presence in those books, and to establish the argument by mentioning Him in them. If his mention in something other than the Book of Moses was greater and more apparent to them, then it would be better to infer that than to specify the inference. By the book of Moses.

If the word “Torah” in this regard is interpreted as referring to the type of books, as it is found in the language of those of the Companions and Followers who spoke of that, then it would be This is for the purpose of clarifying and praising the Qur’an and the previous books, and making them confirm one another.

We have been commanded to believe in what was given to the prophets in absolute terms, as God Almighty said: “Say, ‘We believe in God and in what was revealed to us and what was revealed to Abraham.’” And Ishmael, and Isaac, and Jacob, and the tribes, and what was given to Moses and Jesus, and what was given to the prophets from their Lord. We make no distinction between any of them, and we belong to him. Muslims} [Al-Baqarah: 136].
And he said: {But righteous is he who believes in God and the Last Day and the angels and the Scripture and the prophets} [Al-Baqarah: 177].

The Psalms were mentioned singly in two places in the Qur’an, in His saying: {Indeed, We have revealed to you just as We revealed to Noah and the prophets after him. And We revealed to Abraham, and Ishmael, and Isaac, and Jacob, and the tribes, and Jesus, and Job, and Yunus, and Aaron, and Solomon, and We gave David the Zabur. And messengers whom We have related to you before, and messengers whom We have not related to you. And God spoke to Moses as messengers bringing good tidings and warnings, lest there should be People have a proof against God after the Messengers, and God is Mighty, Wise.} [An-Nisa: 163].
And He - the Almighty - said: {And We certainly favored some of the prophets over others, and We gave David the Psalms} [Al-Isra: 55].
He mentioned it separately.

He mentioned the Book of Moses with this addition, not in the wording of the Torah in more than one place, and he said: {Is he who is on clear proof from his Lord and recites it? A witness from him and before him is the Book of Moses, a guide and a mercy.

And he said: {Say: Have you seen if it is from God and you disbelieve in it, and a witness from the Children of Israel bears witness to the like of it and then believes, but you are arrogant? Indeed, God He does not guide the wrongdoing people} [Al-Ahqaf: 10].
To what he said..

{And before it was the Book of Moses as a guide and a mercy, and this is a Book confirming the Arabic language, to warn those who do wrong and to bring good news to the doers of good.} [Al-Ahqaf: 12].
And He - the Almighty - said.

{And they did not estimate God as He deserved when they said, “God has not sent down anything to mankind.” Say, “Who sent down the Book which Moses brought as a light and a guidance for the people?” [Al-An'am: 91].
And He - the Almighty - said: {Then We gave Moses the Scripture, complete for him who did good.} [Al-An’am: 154].

And if the word “Torah” refers to the Books that are with all the People of the Book, and the Psalms and others are included in this name, and the appearance of His name and epithet in the Torah, and the presence of that among them, and its repetition with the utmost power, and their knowledge of that was as they know it. It is clear and clear that if these books are recognized by their common people, then nothing of them has been hidden, rather they remain as they were.

chapters.title: Chapter of the Fourth Annunciation from David, peace be upon him
paragraphs: [Chapter: Fourth glad tidings from David, peace be upon him]

And they said: David said in his psalm: “Let the valleys and their villages rest in peace, and let the land of Qidar become meadows, and let the cave dwellers sing praises and shout for joy.” The mountains give thanks to the Lord, and spread his praises throughout the isles.”

Whose nations belong to the valleys other than the nation of Muhammad? Who is Qaidar other than Ibn Ismail, the grandfather of the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace? Who are the inhabitants of the caves and those mountains except Arabs?

chapters.title: Chapter of the fifth gospel from David, peace be upon him
paragraphs: [Chapter: The fifth good news from David, peace be upon him]

David said in his psalm: “And it will go from sea to sea, and from the rivers to the uttermost part of the earth, and the people of the islands will fall among His hands, His enemies will lick the dust, the Persian kings will prostrate to Him, the nations will owe Him obedience and submission, and He will save the wretched and persecuted. Who is stronger than him, and rescues the weak who has no helper, and is compassionate to the poor and the weak, and blessings be upon him, and he is blessed at all times.”

These characteristics apply to Muhammad and his nation, not to Christ, for he lived from the Roman Sea to the Persian Sea, and from The rivers of Gihon and Sihon, to the point of the land in the west, as he said: “The earth has been made for me, its easts and its wests, and it will reach “The dominion of my nation is what has been given to me of it.”

And he is blessed and blessed at all times: in every prayer in the five daily prayers and others, each of his nation says: O God, bless Muhammad and the family of Muhammad, And bless Muhammad and the family of Muhammad, may blessings and blessings be upon them.

From there, the people of the islands fell down before him, the people of the Arabian Peninsula, the people of the island between the Euphrates and the Tigris, and the people of the Cyprus, and the people of the island of Andalusia.

The Persian kings submitted to him, and nothing remained of them except those who converted to Islam or paid the jizyah by hand while they were small. Unlike the Roman kings, there were those among them who did not submit to Islam and paid tribute. For this reason, the kings of Persia were singled out for him, and the nations that knew him condemned him. And you know his nation, it was either a believer in him, or a hypocritical submission to him, or a reconciling one, or a fear of them. And He saved the weak from the tyrants.

This is in contrast to Christ; For he did not achieve this ability during his lifetime, nor did those who followed him after his death achieve this ability, nor did they attain what was mentioned, nor did he pray. May blessings be upon him, day and night, for the people claim his divinity.

chapters.title: Chapter on the testimony of Isaiah, the donkey rider and the camel rider
paragraphs: [Chapter: The testimony of the Book of Isaiah “The rider of the donkey and the rider of the camel”]

And they said - in the prophecy of Isaiah -: Isaiah said: “It was said to me: Stand up and look and see what you see.” So I said: I see two riders coming, one of them on the "Babylon and her companions have fallen into the pit."
They said: The rider on the donkey is the Messiah, and the rider on the camel is Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace, and he is more famous for riding a camel than for Christ. The donkey.
Through Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace, the idols of Babylon fell.

chapters.title: Detailing the earlier books’ glad tidings of Christ and Muhammad and their warning of the Antichrist
paragraphs: [Chapter: The previous books’ good news of the Messiah and Muhammad and their warning of the Antichrist]

What should be known is that the previous books gave good tidings about Christ, just as they gave good tidings about Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace, and they also warned With the Antichrist.

The three nations - Muslims, Jews and Christians - agree that the prophets warned of the Antichrist and warned against him, as The Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, said in the authentic hadith: “There is no prophet who did not warn his nation of the Antichrist, even Noah warned his nation. And I will tell you about it something that no prophet ever said to his nation: He is one-eyed, and indeed your Lord is not one-eyed. It is written between his eyes (KFR), so he will read it. Every believer, whether a reader or a non-reader.”
The three nations agree that the prophets announced the Messiah from the descendants of David. The three nations agreed to announce the Messiah as guidance, from the descendants of David.
And the Messiah of misguidance, and they agree that the Messiah of misguidance has not yet come, and they agree that the Messiah of guidance will come - as well.
Then Muslims and Christians agree that the Messiah of guidance is Jesus, son of Mary, and the Jews deny that he is Jesus, son of Mary. Even though they acknowledged that he was a descendant of David.

They said: “Because the Messiah who was preached is believed in by all nations,” and they claimed that the Messiah, the son of Mary, was sent with the religion of the Christians, and it is a religion Appearance of invalidity.

The Christians acknowledge that Christ, the Messiah of guidance, was sent, and it is stated that he will come a second time, but they claim that this second coming It is on the Day of Resurrection that He will reward people for their deeds, and He - according to their claim - is God, and God who is Divinity comes in His humanity, as زَعَمُوا أَنَّهُ جَاءَ قَبْلَ ذَلِكَ.

As for Muslims; So they believed in what the prophets told him on his face, and it agrees with what the Seal of the Messengers told him, as he said in the authentic hadith: “It is about to be That the son of Mary descend among you as a just arbiter and a just imam, and he breaks the cross, kills the pig, and imposes the jizya.”

He reported in the authentic hadith: “When the one-eyed false Messiah of misguidance comes out, Jesus, son of Mary, will descend on the white minaret east of Damascus, between two hills, placing his hands on the shoulders of two kings. Then, when the Antichrist sees him rising as salt dissolves in water, he will overtake him and kill him with a spear at the eastern gate of Lydd, for a period of ten days. Steps from Him,” and this is the interpretation of the Almighty’s saying: “And there is not one of the People of the Book except that he should believe in him before his death” [An-Nisa: 159].

That is: He believes in Christ before he dies, when he descends to earth, and at that time there will remain neither Jew nor Christian, and only religion will remain. Islam, and this is found in its epithet among the People of the Book.

But the Christians thought that he would come after the Resurrection, and that he was God, so they were wrong about that, just as they were wrong about his first coming. Because they thought that he was God, and the Jews denied his first coming, and they thought that the one who was preached about was not him, and that he was not the one who would come last. And they began to wait for someone else, but he was sent to them first, so they rejected him. He will come to them a second time, and everyone on the face of the earth will believe in him. Jew and Christian, except for those who were killed or died, and it appears that those who denied him lied and accused his mother of slander, and said:
He was born of adultery, and these are those who exaggerated in him and said: He is God.

When the Messiah, peace be upon him, was descending among the nation of Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace, there was a connection between him and Muhammad that did not exist between him and anyone other than Muhammad. For this reason, the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, said in the authentic hadith: “Indeed, the people closest to Maryam’s son is because I am, for there is no prophet between me and him.” It was narrated: “How can a nation be destroyed, of which I am at the beginning, and Jesus is at the end of it?” This is what shows the occasion of their conjunction, as narrated by Isaiah; Where he said: “The donkey rider and the camel rider.”

chapters.title: Chapter of Isaiah's message regarding Mecca
paragraphs: [Chapter: The good news of Isaiah regarding Mecca]

They said: And the Prophet Isaiah, peace be upon him, prophesying in Mecca - may God honor it - said: “Raise your sight to what is around you, and you will rejoice and rejoice in it.” So that the treasures of the sea will come to you, and the armies of the nations will mount a pilgrimage to you, until the rain of wet camels will overwhelm you, and your land will be restricted from The drops that will come to you, and the rams of Midian will be brought to you, and the people of Sheba will come to you, and the sheep of Paran will go to you, and men will serve you Ma’rib,” he means the custodians of the Kaaba, who are the sons of Ma’rib ibn Ismail.

They said: All of these characteristics occurred in Mecca, and the relics of the two Bahrains were carried there, and the armies of the nations made pilgrimages to it, and sheep were driven there. Paran - gifts and sacrifices - and (Paran) is the vast wilderness in which Mecca is located, and the land is too narrow for the drops of wet camels. It carries people and their supplies to it, and the people of Sheba, who are the people of Yemen, came to it.

chapters.title: Chapter of the third gospel from Isaiah
paragraphs: [Chapter: The Third Gospel from Isaiah]

They said: And he said: Isaiah the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, announcing in the name of the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace: “I have made your command, O Muhammad, O Holy is the Lord, your name has existed forever.” They said: Is there any room left after that for the one who deviates? He said: Or for the stabber? And Isaiah’s saying: The name of Muhammad has existed forever is in agreement with the saying of David, which we related: That his name existed before the sun.
And his saying: “O Holy One of the Lord” means O one whom the Lord has purified, saved from his humanity, and chosen for himself.

chapters.title: Chapter of the Fourth Gospel from Isaiah
paragraphs: [Chapter: The fourth good news from Isaiah]

They said: And Isaiah said - and he bore witness to this nation of goodness and religion -: “I will raise up a flag for the people of the earth afar off, and it will whistle to them from to the ends of the earth, and they will come quickly.”

The call is what the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, brought as the talbiyah during Hajj, and they were the ones who gave God dignity, so they united Him and worshiped Him. They singled him out for divinity, destroyed the idols, and destroyed the idols. The raised flag is prophecy, and its whistle is an invitation to his house and his feelings, so they come to him listening and obedient.

chapters.title: Fifth Gospel chapter from Isaiah
paragraphs: [Chapter: Fifth Gospel from Isaiah]

They said: And the Prophet Isaiah said - and what is meant is Mecca, which God Almighty has honored -: Walk and be shaken, O barren one who has not given birth, and speak praises. And rejoice if you do not conceive, for your family will be greater than my family - he means by its people: the Holy House, and by the barren he means: Mecca is honored God; Because she did not give birth before our Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, and it is not permissible for the barren to mean the Holy House; Because it is a house for the prophets and a source of revelation, that spot has never ceased to generate.

chapters.title: Chapter Sixth Gospel from Isaiah
paragraphs: [Chapter: Sixth Gospel from Isaiah]

They said: And the Prophet Isaiah said - and he stated the seal of prophecy -: “To us a boy is born, who will be a wonder and a human being, and the mole is on his shoulders, the pillar of peace. He is a mighty God, and His authority is the authority of peace, and He is the son of His scholar, sitting on the throne of David.

They said: The Arkan, he is the great one in the language of the Bible, and the great Arkans. And when Christ healed a demoniac of his insanity, the Jews said: “This man does not cast out devils from human beings except by the most powerful of the devils.” They meant Their greatness. Christ said in the Gospel: “The cornerstone of the world will be judged.” He meant either Satan or the great evil among humans, and he called him a god in a manner similar to The Torah says: “Indeed, God made Moses a god to Pharaoh.” That is, ruling over it and disposing of it, and in the same way as David said to the great men of his people: “You are gods.”

Isaiah testified to the validity of the prophecy of Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace, and described it with its most specific and clearest signs, which is his birthmark, so by my life The mole did not belong to Solomon, nor did it belong to the Messiah. He described him as sitting on the throne of David, meaning that he would inherit the children of Israel and their prophecy. And their kingdom, and extorts their leadership.

chapters.title: Chapter of the seventh gospel from Isaiah
