paragraphs: [Chapter: Seventh Gospel from Isaiah]

They said: And Isaiah said in describing the nation of Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace: “The desert and the cities will be filled with the children of Qidar praising God, and The tops of the mountains call out, they are the ones who give honor to God, and praise Him on land and sea. And Qidhar is the son of Ishmael by agreement. People, Rabia and Mudar from his sons, and Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace, from Mudar.
This fullness and praise did not happen to them except through the sending of Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace.

chapters.title: Chapter of the eighth gospel from Isaiah
paragraphs: [Chapter: Eighth Gospel from Isaiah]

They said: And Isaiah said - and what is meant is Mecca -: “I have drawn you on my palm, and your children will come to you quickly, and whoever wants to He will frighten you and betray you, so raise your eyes to what is around you, for they will come to you and gather against you, so call by my name. For I am the living. Let you put on robes and adorn yourself with a diadem, like a bride, and let your ruins be limited because of the multitude of your inhabitants and those who call upon you, and let everyone fear He will fight against you, and let your children multiply until you say, “Who has provided me with all of these, when I am alone and alone, and they see a slave, so who has raised me?” These people, who took care of them for me?

They said: This - also - is from Isaiah regarding the Kaaba, for it is the one that God clothed with luxurious brocade, and entrusted with its service. Caliphs and kings, and Mecca: it is the place for which God raised children from among its pilgrims and those residing there. This is because Mecca is the one from which everyone who wanted to frighten it and destroy it was expelled, and it remains dear, honorable, and forbidden, and no one insults it. No human being at all. Rather, the owners of the elephant, when they went to it, God punished them with the famous punishment, and it continued to remain inhabited by Hajj, from the presence of Abraham. Hebron.

Unlike the House of Jerusalem, it was destroyed time after time, emptied of its inhabitants, and the enemy took control of it and its people, as well as Telling him of the insult to everyone who opposes it: It belongs to the Kaaba rather than the Holy House. The Almighty said: {And whoever averts therein atheism with injustice, We will make him taste from A painful punishment} [Al-Hajj: 25].
Al-Hajjaj bin Yusuf was a venerator of the Kaaba.

He did not shoot it with a catapult, but rather specifically targeted Ibn al-Zubayr. As for the large number of her children, who make pilgrimages to her and receive her in their prayers, they are many times greater than the number of the children of Jerusalem.

chapters.title: Chapter of the Ninth Gospel of Isaiah
paragraphs: [Chapter: The Ninth Gospel of Isaiah]

They said: And Isaiah - speaking on behalf of God Almighty - said: “Give thanks for my love and my son Ahmed,” so God called him beloved and called him a son, and David a different son. God singled him out for an advantage over them and said, “Love my son, I thank him.” So Isaiah worshiped by thanking Muhammad, and directed his thanks to him and his people. And honoring him, so that his value and status with him would be made clear, and that was an honor that no other messengers were given.

And Isaiah said: “We have only heard from the ends of the earth the voice of Muhammad,” and this is a statement from Isaiah in the name of the Messenger of God, may God bless him. Peace be upon him, so let the People of the Book show us a prophet whose name has been explicitly mentioned by the prophets, except the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace.

chapters.title: Chapter on the glad tidings of Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace, from Habakkuk
paragraphs: [Chapter: The good news of Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace, from Habakkuk]

They said: And Habakkuk said: - And Muhammad was named the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, explicitly twice in his prophecy -: “Indeed, God has come from the south. And the Holy One from Mount Paran. The heavens were illuminated by the splendor of Muhammad, and the earth was filled with his praise. His rays looked like light, surrounding His country is proud, the calamities pass before him, and lions of birds accompany his hosts. He rose up and surveyed the land, and the ancient mountains humbled themselves before him. And the hills fell, and the curtains of the people of Midian were shaken.”

Then he said: “He rebuked you in the rivers, and began your fast in the seas. You rode horses and mounted dispatch chariots, and you will draw sweats from your bows.” And the arrows are quenched at your command, O Muhammad, and the mountains have seen you and have been terrified, and the rays of the torrent have turned away from you, and you have changed. The abysses changed and terrified, they raised their hands in awe and fear, and the armies marched in the gleam of your arrows and the shine of your meteors, and the earth reeled with anger, And you will trample the nations with rebuke, because you appeared to save your nation and to preserve the heritage of your fathers.”

They said: This is a statement about Muhammad, and whoever attempts to deny this prophecy of Habakkuk about Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace, has sought the cover of the day and is imprisoned. Rivers, and how can he do that? ! He called it by name twice, and told of the strength of his nation, and the march of death before them, and the wings of birds following their tracks. This prophecy is only suitable for Muhammad, and is only suitable for him, and indicates no one but him, so whoever tries to turn it away from him has tried to abstain.

He mentioned in it the coming of God’s light from Al-Tayman - which is the direction of Mecca and the Hijaz - for the prophets of the children of Israel were from The region of the Levant, and Muhammad came from the region
Yemen, and the mountains of Paran are the mountains of Mecca - as was previously explained - and this is something that cannot be disputed.

As for the heavens being filled with the splendor of Ahmad, with the lights of faith and the Qur’an that appeared from him and his nation, and the earth being filled with His praise, He praised his nation in their prayers, so this is a clear matter. For his nation are the ones who give praise. They must praise God in every prayer and sermon, and every praying person in every rak’ah must say: {Praise be to Him. To Allah belongs the Lord of the worlds - the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful - Master of the Day of Judgment} [Al-Fatihah: 2-4].
So when he says: {Praise be to God, Lord of the worlds} [Al-Fatihah: 2].
God said: My servant praised me.
So when he said: {The Most Gracious, the Most Merciful} [Al-Fatihah: 3].
He said: My servant praised me.
So when he said: {Master of the Day of Judgment} [Al-Fatihah: 4].
He said: My servant glorified Me.

They begin the prayer with praise, and they end it with praise, and when they raise their heads from bowing, their imam says: God hears. To those who praise Him, and they say: All of us, “Our Lord, to You is all praise,” and they conclude their prayer with praise. He makes greetings, prayers, and good things for Him. And the types of their praise of God, which would take a long time to describe.

chapters.title: Gospel chapter from Ezekiel
paragraphs: [Chapter: Good News from Ezekiel]

They said: And Ezekiel said - while he was threatening the Jews and describing to them the nation of Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace -: “And indeed God will make them prevail over you. And He will raise up among you a Prophet, and He will send down to them a Book, and their dominion will be your slaves. They will oppress you and humiliate you justly, and the men of Banu Qaydhar will emerge in Groups of peoples, with them are angels on white horses, armed, surrounding you, and your end will lead to Hell. We seek refuge in God from Hell.”

This is because the men of Banu Qaydhar are (Rabi’a) and (Mudar), the sons of Adnan, and they are all descendants of Qaydhar ibn Ismail, and they are all Arabs. From Bani Adnan and Bani Qahtan. So Adnan - Abu Rabi’ah - and Mudar and Anmar are from the descendants of Ismail, according to people’s agreement. As for Qahtan, it was said that they were from the descendants of Ishmael, and it was said that they were from the descendants of Hud. Mudar is the descendant of Ilyas ibn Mudar, and Quraysh are the descendants of Ilyas ibn Mudar, and the Hawazin are like Aqil, Kilab, Saad ibn Bakr, and Banu Numayr, Thaqif and others are from the descendants of Ilyas bin Mudar.

These people spread throughout the land, and they took control of the lands of the Levant, the Peninsula, Egypt, Iraq, and other places, to the point that when they inhabited the peninsula, Between the Euphrates and the Tigris, Mudar lived in Harran and what was close to it, so it was called Diyar Mudar, and Rabi’ah lived in Mosul and what was close to it. So it was called the house of Rabia.

chapters.title: Two glad tidings from Daniel, peace be upon him
paragraphs: [Chapter: Two glad tidings from Daniel, peace be upon him]

And he said: Daniel, peace be upon him, and he mentioned Muhammad, the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, by name, and he said: “You will draw water from your bows, and it will be quenched.” "The arrows are at your command, O Muhammad, at your command."
This is a statement without exposition.
Correction does not contain nursing.
If someone disputes about this, then let us find someone else named Muhammad, who has arrows that can be drawn, and a command that is obeyed and cannot be rebuffed.

And he said: Daniel the Prophet - also - when Bukht Nasr asked him about the interpretation of a vision he saw, then forgot: “O king, I saw a great idol standing In your hands, his head is made of gold, his forearms are made of silver, his belly and thighs are made of brass, his legs are made of iron, and his feet are made of pottery. And I saw a stone that had not been cut by the hand of man. He came and shaped that idol, and it disintegrated and vanished and returned as remains. Then the wind blew it away, so it was gone and transformed. That stone became a great mountain until it filled the entire earth. This is what you saw, O king?
Bakht Nasr said: He is right. What is its interpretation?

Daniel said: “You are the head of gold that I saw, and after you will arise your sons whom you saw of silver, and they are inferior to you. After them there will be another kingdom, which is below them.

It is like brass, and the fourth kingdom will be strong like iron, which beats all things. As for the feet that you saw, they were made of clay. The kingdom is weak and its word is dispersed, and as for the stone that you saw that was minted that great idol and you crumbled it, it is a prophet whom God will raise up. heaven and earth from his tribe with a strong law, and all the kings of the earth and the nations thereof shall be struck, until the earth be filled with him and his nation. The authority of that prophet will last until the end of the world. This is an expression of your vision, O king.”

This is the description of Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace, not the description of the Messiah, for he is the one who was sent with a strong law, and he defeated all the kings and nations of the earth. Until the earth was filled with him and his nation in the east and west of the earth, and his dominion was permanent, and no one was able to remove it as it was removed. The kingship of the Jews and the kingship of the Christians has passed away from the best and middle parts of the earth.

chapters.title: Chapter of the third gospel from Daniel, peace be upon him
paragraphs: [Chapter: The third good news from Daniel, peace be upon him]

And the Prophet Daniel - also - said: “I asked God and pleaded with Him to make clear to me what would happen among the children of Israel, and would He turn to them in repentance and return to them.” He will establish their king and send prophets among them, or will do that to others.” Daniel said: “Then the king appeared to me in the form of a young man with a beautiful face. He said: Peace be upon you, O Daniel. God Almighty says:

Indeed, the children of Israel angered me, rebelled against me, and worshiped other gods besides me, and they turned from knowledge to ignorance, and from truth to Lying, so I sent the victory of Nasr over them, killing their men and captivating their descendants, demolishing their sanctuary, and burning their books. And so did those who After him, I am not satisfied with them and I will not put up with their offenses, so they will not cease from My wrath until I send my anointed, the son of the Virgin Mary. So I conclude

At that time, curses and wrath will be upon them, and they will continue to be cursed, subject to humiliation and poverty, until I send the Prophet of the Children of Ishmael, to whom I gave good tidings. He migrated therewith, and I sent my angel to her, and he gave her the good news. Then I was inspired to that prophet, and I taught him the names, and I decorated him with piety, and I made righteousness His motto, piety is his conscience, honesty is his speech, loyalty is his nature, intention is his conduct, and righteousness is his practice. I specialize him in a book confirming what is clear. from the books in his hands, and he abrogated part of what was in them. I will take him to Me and I will raise him from heaven to heaven until he ascends, so I will bring him near and greet him. And I was inspired to him, then I returned him to My servants with happiness and happiness, preserving what was entrusted to him, fulfilling what he was commanded, calling to My Oneness with gentle speech. And the one who exhorts is neither harsh nor harsh nor loud in the markets. He is kind to whoever follows him, merciful to whoever believes in him, and is harsh toward whoever is hostile to him. So he supplicates. His people to
My monotheism and my worship, and he tells them what he saw of My signs, but they deny him and harm him.

The bearer of this good news said: They said: Then Daniel narrated the story of the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, word for word, from what the king dictated to him. Until he reached the last days of his nation with the blow and the end of the world, and his prophecy was many, and it is now in the hands of Christians and Jews who are reading it.

And whatever we describe of what God has mentioned of this nation and its prophet, and the connection of their kingdom with the Resurrection - I said: This is a prophecy. Daniel contains the good news of the Messiah, and the good news of Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace, and it contains a description of Muhammad and his nation in great detail. He described it, and the Muslims read it when they conquered Iraq, as the scholars mentioned, including Abu Al-Aaliyah: He mentioned that when they conquered (to cover) They found Daniel dead, and they found a Qur’an with him.

Abu Al-Aliyah said: I read that Qur’an, and in it are your descriptions and the tone of your words, and when the people of the district were indifferent, they revealed His grave and they were given water, so Abu Musa wrote about that to Omar bin Al-Khattab.
So Omar wrote to him: “Dig thirteen graves during the day, and bury him in one of them at night, so that people will not be tempted by him.”

chapters.title: A chapter on what was transmitted about the good news of Christ through Muhammad and a detailed commentary on it
paragraphs: [Chapter: What was transmitted of the good news of Christ through Muhammad and the detailed commentary on it]
They said: And John the Evangelist said: Jesus Christ said - in the fifteenth chapter of his Gospel -: “The Pharisee is the spirit of truth that he sends.” Father, he will teach you all things.”

And John - the disciple - also said about Christ, that he said to his disciples: “If you love me, keep my commandments, and I will ask the Father To give you another Paraclete, who will abide with you forever, the Spirit of truth, whom the world could not kill because they knew him. I will not leave you orphans, for I will come to you soon.”

And John said: Christ said: “He who loves me will keep my word, and my Father will love him, and he will come to him, and with him he will abide. These things I have told you; For I dwell with you, and the Pharisee, the spirit of truth, which my Father will send, will teach you all things, and will bring to your remembrance all that I have said to you. I have entrusted you with my peace. Do not let your hearts be anxious and do not be afraid, for I am departing and returning to you. If you loved me, you would rejoice in my going. To the Father, if you abide in my words and my words abide in you, you will have whatever you want, and in this my Father will be glorified.”

He also said: “When the Paraclete whom my Father sent, the Spirit of truth who is from my Father, comes, he will bear witness of me. I have told you this so that when Believe in him and do not doubt him.”

He also said: “It is better for you that I go away, because if I do not go, Paraclete will not come to you. So when I go, I will send him to you. He is He rebukes the world for sin, and I have many things I want to say, but you cannot bear them. But if that Spirit of truth comes He will guide you into all the truth, for he will not speak on his own authority, but he will speak what he hears, and he will declare to you everything that is to come, and he will make known to you all that comes. "For the father."
John the Apostle said: Christ said: “The worst of the world is coming, and I have nothing.”

And Matthew the disciple said: Christ said: “Have they not read that the stone which the builders cast aside became the head of the corner from God? This was - And it is wonderful in our eyes - and for this reason I say to you: The kingdom of God will be taken from you and given to another nation that will eat its fruit, and If he falls on this stone, he will be cut off, and everyone on whom it falls will be destroyed.”

And John the disciple said - in the book of the disciples' letters, called Pharisees -: “My beloved, beware of believing with every spirit. The spirits that are from God are from others, and know that every spirit that believes that Jesus Christ came and was corporeal, is from God, and every spirit that does not believe that Jesus Christ has come, and was carnal, is not from God, but from the false Christ about whom you have heard, And now he is in the world.”
And Simeon of Cephas, the chief of the Apostles, said - in the Book of Pharaxis -: “The time has come for rule to begin from the House of God, beginning.”

I said: And this word, the word Al-Faraqlit, in their language they mentioned sayings about it: It was said: It is the Hammad, and it was said: It is Al-Hamid, and it was said: It is Al-Mu'izz, and it was said: It is praise, and a group said this was more likely; And they said: The proof for it in their language is that it is praise, and the evidence for it is the saying of Joshua: “Whoever does a good deed, it will be a good deed for him.” That is, good praise - and their famous saying in their correspondence: Faarqalitan, Faraqalitan, and what is more than all of them - that is, praise - and from it, as we say. We: a hand and a blessing and whoever said:

It means the Savior, so they argue that it is a Syriac word, meaning the Savior, and they say: It is derived from our saying: “Rauf,” and it is said In Syriac, it is “Farouk”, so it was made “Fariq”. They said: The meaning of “Lit” is a word that is added, and the appreciation is as it is said in Arabic: a man is, a stone is, a full moon is, and a male is. They said: Likewise, “Layt” is added in Syriac. And those who said: He is the goat, said: In the Greek language, it is the goat.

An objection to these two statements is that Christ’s language was neither Syriac nor Greek, but rather Hebrew. It is answered that he spoke in Hebrew, and had it translated in another language, just as they dictated one of the Gospels in Greek, and the other In Roman.

And one remained a Hebrew. Most Christians regard him as the Savior, and Christ - himself - they call him the Savior, and in the Gospel that is in their hands, he said: “I did not come Not to beautify the world, but to save the world.” And the Christians say in their prayers: “You have born to us a Savior.”

There was disagreement about it. Among the Christians were those who said: It is a spirit that descended on the disciples, and they may say: It is tongues of fire that descended from the sky on disciples, and she performed signs and wonders; That is why those who know the conditions of the Christians say that they did not see any of them capable of realizing the coming of this promised Paraclete.

Among them are those who claim that he is the Messiah - himself - because he came forty days after the crucifixion, and because he rose from his grave. Interpreting it by the Spirit is invalid, and even more invalid is interpreting it by Christ for reasons: among them: that the Holy Spirit continues to descend upon the prophets. And the righteous before and after Christ, and this is what the People of the Book agreed upon: that the Holy Spirit descended on the prophets and the righteous before Christ and after him, and she was not described with these qualities, and God Almighty said:

{You will not find a people who believe in God and the Last Day being friendly with those who oppose God and His Messenger, even if they are their fathers or their sons or Their brothers or their clan - these are those in whose hearts He wrote faith and supported them with a spirit from Him.} [Al-Mujadila: 22].

“And he said: The Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, told Hassan bin Thabit, when he was attacking the polytheists, he said: “O God, support him with the Holy Spirit,” and he said: “The The Holy Spirit is with you as you continue to defend His Prophet.”

If this is the case and no one calls this spirit Paraclete, this indicates that Paraclete is something other than this. Also, prophets and righteous people continue to support such things, and what Christ preached is a great matter. After him, there will come something greater than This, and also that he described Al-Faraqalite with characteristics that do not suit this, but rather suit a man who will come after him as his counterpart, for he said: (If If you love me and keep my commandments, I ask the Father to give you another Paraclete, who will abide with you forever.” So he said:

(Another Paraclete) indicates that he is a second to the first who was before him, and there was no one with them during the life of Christ except him, and no spirit descended upon them. So he knew that the one who would come after him as his counterpart was not a usual thing that would happen to people.

Also, he said: (He abides with you forever), and this is only for what lasts, and remains with them until the end of time. It is known that he did not want the survival of himself, so he knew that it was the survival of his law and command, so it was known that the first Paraclete did not confirm his law with them. His religion is forever, and this shows that the second one is the owner of a law that cannot be abrogated unlike the first, and this only applies to Muhammad, may God’s prayers and peace be upon him. He said hello.

And also, he told them that this Paraclete about whom he told was a witness for him, and teaching them all things, and that he would remind you of everything he said. Christ, and that he rebukes the world for its sin, saying: (And the Paraclete that my Father will send, he will teach you all things, and he will remind you every I told you.)
And he said: (When the Paraclete whom my father sent comes, he will bear witness for me. I told you this so that when it happens, you will believe in it and not doubt it.)

And he said: (It is better for you that I go away, because if I do not go, the Paraclete will not come to you. If I go away, I will send him to you. He is He rebukes the world for sin, and I have many things to say, but you cannot bear them, but when that Spirit of truth comes Who guides you into all the truth; for he does not speak on his own authority, but he will speak what he hears, and he will declare all that comes and make it known to you. All that belongs to the father).

These characteristics and descriptions that they received about Christ do not apply to anything in the hearts of some people that no one sees or hears His words. It applies to the one whom people see and hear his words, and he bears witness to Christ, and teaches them all things, and reminds them of everything that Christ said to them, He rebukes the world for sin, and guides people into all the truth. He does not speak on his own authority, but speaks from what he hears and declares to them. With everything that comes, and He makes known to them everything that belongs to the Lord of the Worlds.

This is not an angel that no one can see, nor is he guidance or knowledge in the hearts of some people. Rather, he is nothing but a person of great worth who addresses the people. By what Christ told him, and this is only a human being and a messenger, but rather greater than Christ, he made it clear that he is capable of what he is not able to do. Christ, and he knows what Christ does not know, and he declares everything that is coming, and what the Lord deserves, as he said:

(I have many things I want to say, but you cannot bear them. But if the Spirit of truth comes, who will guide you into all the truth, For he does not speak on his own authority, but he will speak what he hears, and he will declare to you what is to come, and he will make known to you all the things of the Father.

These attributes only apply to Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace, and that is because informing about God of what is characterized by Him is one of the attributes. And about His angels, and about His kingdom, and about what God has prepared in Paradise for His friends, and in Hell for His enemies, is something that the minds of many cannot bear. Some people know him in detail; That is why Ali, may God be pleased with him, said: “Speak to the people of what they know, and leave behind what they deny. Do you want God and His Messenger to be denied?”

Ibn Masoud said: “There is no man who narrates to a people a hadith that their minds cannot comprehend except that it is a temptation for some of them.” A man asked Ibn Abbas about the Almighty’s saying: “He created seven heavens and from the earth the like of them; the matter descends between them” [At-Talaq: 12].

He said: “What gives you faith that if I had told you its interpretation, you would have disbelieved? And your disbelief in it is your denial of it.” So Christ, peace be upon him, said to them: (I have many words that I want to say, but you are not able to carry them), and he is the truthful and trustworthy in this. ; For this reason, there are only general matters in the Gospel of the attributes of God, the attributes of His kingdom, and the attributes of the Last Day. Likewise, the Torah does not contain anything He mentioned the Last Day, except for general matters, even though Moses had prepared the matter for Christ, and despite this, Christ said to them:

(I have many words that I want to say, but you are not able to carry them), then he said: (But when the Spirit of truth comes, he who will guide you To all truth), and he said: (He will declare to you everything that is coming, and he will make known to you all that is the Lord’s).

This indicates that this Paraclete is the one who does this instead of Christ, and likewise Muhammad, may God’s prayers and peace be upon him, was the one who guided the people. To all the truth, until God completed the religion for him, and completed the blessing through him; For this reason, he was the Seal of the Prophets, as there was nothing left for anyone else to bring, and Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace, was informed of everything that would come from him. The signs of the Hour, the Resurrection, the reckoning, the path, the weight of deeds, Paradise and the types of its bliss, Hell and the types of its torment, For this reason, the Qur’an contains details about the Hereafter, and mentions of Paradise and Hell, and many matters that come from that are not found in the Torah. Not in the Gospel, and that confirms what Christ said:
He tells everything that is coming.

And Muhammad was sent by God before the Hour, as he said: “I and the Hour have been sent like these,” and he pointed with his index and middle fingers. And when he mentioned the Hour, he would raise his voice, and his face would turn red, and his anger would intensify as if he were warning an army, and he would say: {He is but a warner to you among My hand is a severe punishment} [Saba: 46].
And he said: “I am the naked Nazirite.”

So he informed of the things that would come in the future that which no prophet had brought, as Christ described him when he said: (It is He informs you of everything that is to come), and there has never been anything like this reported from any of the prophets before Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace.
In addition to the fact that there was something that touched the hearts of some of the disciples.

And also, he said: (And he will make known to you all that belongs to the Lord), thus making it clear that he makes known to people all that belongs to God, and that deals with the names and attributes that belong to God, And what rights He has, and what is required of believing in Him, His angels, His books, and His messengers, so that what He brings is a comprehensive of all that The Lord deserves it.

This was not brought by anyone other than Muhammad, as it includes what he brought of the Book and the wisdom, this is all of it. It is known that what was revealed to the disciples did not contain all of this, nor half of it, nor a third of it. Rather, what Christ brought was greater than what he brought. The Apostles, and this second Paraclete brought something greater than what Christ brought.
And also, Christ said: “When the Paraclete whom my Father sent comes, he will bear witness for me. I have told you this, so that you may believe in him and not Complain.

In it). So he explained that he told them about it; So that they will believe in Him when He comes, and not doubt Him, and that He will bear witness to Him. This is the characteristic of the one to whom Christ preached, and he bears witness to Christ, as he said. God Almighty: {And when Jesus, son of Mary, said, “O Children of Israel, indeed I am the Messenger of God to you, confirming what was before me of the Torah and bringing good tidings of a Messenger who will come.” After me, his name will be Ahmad” [As-Saff: 6].

He told that he rebukes the world for sin, and there was no one who rebuked the entire world for sin except Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace. For he warned all types of people in the world, and rebuked them for sin: disbelief, immorality, and disobedience, and he rebuked all the polytheists. Of the Arabs, Indians, Turks, and others, and he rebuked the Magi, and their kingdom was the greatest of kingdoms, and he rebuked the People of the Book, the Jews. And the Christians, and he said in the authentic hadith about him: “Indeed, God looked at the people of the earth and detested them, their Arabs and non-Arabs, except for the remnants of the people of The book.
He did not limit himself to just commands and prohibitions, but rather rebuked them, scolded them, and threatened them.

Also, he declared that he does not speak on his own initiative, but rather speaks everything he hears. This is information that everything he speaks is a revelation that he hears, and it is not something he learned from people, or knew by deducing it. This is especially true for Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace, because Christ and the prophets before him were learning from others, despite what was being revealed. To them, for they have knowledge other than the revelation they hear.

Muhammad, may God’s prayers and peace be upon him, did not speak except what he heard from the revelation, so he conveyed what he was sent with, and it was said to him: {Convey what It has been sent down to you from your Lord, and if you do not do it, then you have not conveyed His message, and God will protect you from the people” [Al-Maeda: 67].

So God guaranteed him infallibility if he conveyed his messages, and for this reason he guided the people to all the truth, and conveyed to the people what no one else was able to do. The prophets delivered it; For fear that they would kill him, as they say about Christ and others.

Christ told them that he had not mentioned to them all that he had, and that they could not bear to carry him, and they acknowledged that he was afraid. If he tells them the truth about things. And Muhammad was supported by God in a way that he did not support anyone else, so he protected him from the people so that he was not afraid of anything he said, and gave him the ability to explain. And knowledge is what no one else has given it. The book in which he was sent contains an explanation of the truths of the unseen, as there is no other book in it.

He supported his nation with such support that they were able to bear what he threw at them. They were not like the people of the Torah who carried the Torah and then did not carry it. Nor like the people of the Gospel to whom Christ said: (I have many things that I want to say to you, but you cannot bear them), and there is no doubt that The nation of Muhammad is more complete in intellect, greater in faith, and more complete in belief and jihad. For this reason, their knowledge, heartfelt deeds, and faith were greater.
The physical acts of worship for others were greater. God Almighty said:

{The Messenger believed in what was revealed to him from his Lord, and the believers are each of them who believe in God and His angels and His books and His messengers. We make no distinction between any of His messengers. And they said, “We have heard and obeyed. Your forgiveness is our Lord, and to You is the return.” Our Lord, do not hold us accountable if we forget or make a mistake. Our Lord, and do not place upon us a burden as You placed upon those before us. Our Lord, and do not burden us with what We cannot bear it, but pardon us and forgive us and have mercy on us, You are our Master, so help us against the disbelieving people} [Al-Baqarah: 285-286].
It has been proven in the Sahih on the authority of the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, that God said: I have done it.

Also, it was reported on behalf of the Paraclete that he bears witness of him, and that he teaches them everything, and that he reminds them of everything that Christ said, It is known that this will not happen unless he gives testimony that people will hear. This will not be something in the heart of a small group, and he did not bear witness. One of the witnesses of Christ was heard by the general public, except for Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace. The people of the earth bore witness to him, and they knew that he believed in the Messiah, and kept him separate from what the Jews had slandered him against, and from what the Christians had exaggerated about him. He is the one who bore witness to the truth; For this reason, when Al-Najashi heard from the companions what Muhammad testified about for Christ, he said to them:
(Jesus did not add this promise to what you said.)

And God made the nation of Muhammad as witnesses over the people, bearing witness against them according to what they knew of the truth, since they were just people who did not bear witness to falsehood. A witness can only be fair, unlike one who is unjust in his testimony, whether he adds to the truth or subtracts from it, like the testimony of the Jews and Christians in Christ.

Also, the meaning of the faraklito, whether it is Al-Hamid, Al-Hammad, Al-Hamd, or Al-Mu’izz, then this description is apparent in Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace. Peace and blessings be upon him, for he and his nation are the praiseworthy ones who praise God in every situation, and he is the bearer of the standard of praise, and praise is the key to his sermon. And the key to his prayer, and when he was Hammad, he was rewarded with his description; The reward is of the same type as the work. So his name was Muhammad, and Ahmad.

As for Muhammad, he is highly honored, exalted, and holy, and he is the one who is praised greatly and exaggeratedly, and he deserves that. When he was Muhammad To God, he was Muhammad, and in the poetry of Hassan bin Thabit:
And a part of His name was given to it in order for it to be glorified... So the Possessor of the Throne is praised, and this is Muhammad.

As for Ahmad, he is more virtuous: that is, he is more deserving of being praised than others. It is said: This is Ahmad than that; That is, this one is more deserving of being praised than this one, so he is given preference over others in that he is praiseworthy. The word (Muhammad) implies his virtue in quantity, and the word (Ahmed) implies his virtue in quality. And among the people are those who say: Ahmad; That is, more praiseworthy than others. Accordingly, it means the Praiseworthy and Praiseworthy.

He said: Whoever thinks that the meaning of the faraklito in their language is praise - as mentioned above - then if that is the case, then this is what is stated in the Qur’an: {And bringing good tidings of a Messenger who will come after me, whose name is Ahmad} [As-Saff: 6].

They said: There is no doubt among them that it is a noun derived from praise, like what we say in our language: “tharib” and “mudruoub.” As for whoever interpreted it as “al-Mu’izz,” no prophet has ever been known to have honored the people of monotheism for God and the faith as Muhammad honored them, so he has more right to the name. The comforter of every human being.

As for the meaning of the Savior, it is also evident in it, for Christ is the first Savior as mentioned in the Gospel, and he is known to The Christians said that Christ - may God’s prayers be upon him - was called a Savior, so Christ was the first Paraclete, and he preached about another Paraclete, for he He said: (And I ask the Father to give you another Paraclete, who will abide with you forever), so this is good news of a second Savior who will be confirmed. With them forever, and Christ is the first Savior.

As for what descends into the hearts, no one has called him a Savior, not even Paraclete, so it is not permissible to interpret the words of Christ except in its language and meanings. The well-known thing that he addressed, as well as all the prophets, and even all the other speakers.
He described this second Savior as abiding with them forever, and Muhammad is the Savior who came with a law that will last forever, not It is abrogated.
Also, in the Gospel; The Gospel of John, that Christ said: (The cornerstone of the world will come, and I have nothing).

They mentioned that the Arkun, in their language, are great in power and great arkans, and they used to say about Christ: (Indeed, the Arkun are the devils. He helps him) meaning the greatest of the devils. It is one of the Jews’ slander against Christ. The saying of Christ, peace be upon him: “I am the pillar of the world,” only applies to the great of the world and the master of the world. And the great of the world.

He was informed that he would come, but it was not possible for this archon to be the Messiah, or anyone like him, and no one has come after the Messiah who prevailed. The world, and the world other than Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace, obeyed him, and this is part of the good news of Christ about him.

He was asked, may God bless him and grant him peace, “What was your first matter?” He said: The call of my father Abraham, the good news of Isa, and the vision my mother saw when she gave birth to me that a light came out of her that illuminated the palaces of the Levant.

In short, it is known by the agreement of the people of the earth that after Christ there has not come someone who has dominated the world inwardly and outwardly, and whose hearts have submitted to him. And the bodies, and he was obeyed in secret and in public, during his lifetime and after his death in all eras, and the best regions, east and west, other than Muhammad, For kings are obeyed outwardly and not inwardly, and they are not obeyed after their death, and the people of religion do not obey them in an obedience through which they hope for the reward of God in the world. the Hereafter, and they fear God’s punishment in the Hereafter, unlike the prophets.

And Muhammad revealed the religion of the messengers before him, believed them, and noted their remembrance and glorification, so he believed in the prophets and messengers before Moses. The Messiah and others are great nations. If it were not for Muhammad, they would not have believed in them. And whoever knew these people of the Book, they were different in themselves, just as the People of the Book were different in Christ, and they used to slander David. وَسُلَيْمَانَ وَغَيْرِهِمَا بِمَا هُوَ مَعْرُوفٌ عِنْدَهُمْ.
Also, he mentioned to them some of the messengers that they did not know, such as Hud, Salih, Shuaib, and others.

And Muhammad, may God’s prayers and peace be upon him, believed Christ in his reports; That he is the most powerful of the world, so he said: “I am the master of the children of Adam, and there is no boasting. Adam and those below him are under my banner. I am the speaker of the prophets when they come, and the imam of the prophets when they gather.”

He is the bearer of the standard of praise, and he is the holder of the praiseworthy station, with which the ancients and the last will envy him on the Day of Resurrection, so he is the master of Truly, the worlds, and this is in accordance with the saying of Christ: (He is the most powerful of the world), so he is the most powerful of others in this world and the hereafter, and he is the most powerful of the worlds. The first and the last in the Hereafter.

And the words of Christ: (The most powerful of the world will come, and I have nothing) included the two originals: the confirmation of the Messenger, and the confirmation of monotheism, and that the command It is all for God, and it is the fulfillment of the testimony: that there is no god but God and that Muhammad is the Messenger of God. And Christ’s saying: (I have nothing) is an exaltation of the divinity attributed to him, and this denial is shared by all of creation. God Almighty said To Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace: {You have nothing to do with the matter} [Al Imran: 128].

And God Almighty said: {Say, “I do not say to you that I have the treasures of God, nor do I know the unseen, nor do I say to you that I am an angel. I follow only what is revealed to me.” [Al-An’am: 50] .

And He said: {Say, “Indeed, I have no power over you to harm you nor to guide you.” - Say, “No one will give me protection from God, nor will I find any refuge other than Him.” [Al-Jinn: 21-22] (i.e., a refuge). And a refuge) {Except a message from God and His messages. And whoever disobeys God and His Messenger - for him is the fire of Hell, wherein they will abide forever} [Al-Jinn: 23].
And the Almighty said: {Say: I do not control for myself any benefit or harm except what God wills} [Al-A’raf: 188].

Also, in the prophecy of Isaiah, he described Muhammad as the pillar of peace, and peace and peace: Islam. It shows that he is the master of the religion of Islam. There is no doubt that all the prophets were sent with the religion of Islam. But this religion and its name did not appear, and mention of the religion of Islam spread on earth as it appeared to Muhammad. Muhammad is the pillar of Islam that... He combines all goodness and righteousness, just as Satan is the pillar of evil. The Almighty said on the authority of Noah:

{O my people, if my position and my reminder of the verses of God are too difficult for you, then in God I put my trust. So agree on your affairs and your partners, and then your decision will not be the same. distress upon you, then render judgment to me and do not wait. If you turn back, I have not asked of you for any reward. My reward is only upon God, and I have been commanded to be of Muslims} [Yunus: 71-72].
This is Noah: the first messenger sent by God to the people of the earth. It is mentioned that he was commanded to be among the Muslims.
And the sorcerers said - when they converted to Islam and Pharaoh wanted to kill them -: “Our Lord, pour upon us patience and cause us to die as Muslims” [Al-A’raf: 126].
And he said: {Indeed, We sent down the Torah, in which is guidance and light. The prophets judged by it, who submitted to those who were Jewish.} [Al-Maeda: 44].
And he said: {And when I inspired to the disciples, “Believe in Me and in My Messenger.” They said, “We believe.” And I bear witness that we are Muslims.} [Al-Ma’idah: 111].

If it is said: Christ called the Paraclete the Spirit of Truth, and he called him the Holy Spirit. And God Almighty said about Abraham: {And who would turn away from the religion of Abraham except he who fools himself? And We have chosen him in this world, and indeed he will be in the Hereafter. Of the righteous - when his Lord said to him, “Submit.” He said, “I submit to the Lord of the Worlds.” And he enjoined it on Abraham, his sons, and Jacob, “O my son.” Indeed, God has chosen The religion is yours, so do not die unless you have submitted.} [Al-Baqarah: 130-132].
{And Moses said, “O my people, if you believe in God, then put your trust in Him if you are Muslims” [Yunus: 84].
Bilqis said: {My Lord, I have wronged myself, and I submitted with Solomon to God, Lord of the worlds} [An-Naml: 44].

It was said: John said in the Book of the Chronicles of the Apostles, called (Ephraxis): “My beloved, beware of believing with every spirit. The spirits that are from God are from others, and know that every spirit that believes that Jesus Christ came and was corporeal, it is from God, and every spirit that does not believe that the Messiah has come, and was carnal, is not from God, but from the false Christ who is now in the world.”

And if that is the case, it is known that the spirit - according to them - reaches the prophet sent from mankind, and Gabriel, who sent down the revelation to Muhammad, is the spirit Al-Quds, which is the spirit of truth, as God Almighty said: {Say: It has been sent down by the Holy Spirit from your Lord in truth} [An-Nahl: 102].
And he said: {The Faithful Spirit has descended upon your heart} [Al-Shu’ara’: 193-194].
And he said: {Whoever is an enemy of Gabriel - he has sent it down to your heart, God willing} [Al-Baqarah: 97].

He created this spirit with the coming of Muhammad, and the words that were revealed with it are the ones that Muhammad conveyed. For this reason, God Almighty said: {God selects messengers from the angels and from people} [Al-Hajj: 75].

So God chose Gabriel from among the angels, and chose Muhammad from among humans. For this reason, the saying, which is the Qur’an, is sometimes added to the saying of this, and to the saying of this sometimes, as the Almighty said: {Indeed, it is the saying of a Messenger. Generous - Possessor of power near the One who possesses the throne, secure - obedient, then trustworthy} [Al-Takwir: 19-21].

This Messenger here is Gabriel, and God Almighty said in the other verse: {Indeed, it is the speech of a noble Messenger - and it is not the speech of a little poet. You will not believe - nor in the words of a soothsayer. Little do you remember - a revelation from the Lord of the worlds} [Al-Haqqah: 40-43].

This Messenger here is Muhammad, and he added it to each of them with the word “Messenger.” To ensure that he had conveyed it to him from his sender, he did not say: “It is the speech of an angel, nor of a prophet.” Rather, he declared disbelief on whoever said: It is the speech of humans as it is. This was mentioned on the authority of Al-Wahid, and God Almighty said in the Qur’an: {Allah has sent down to you a reminder - a Messenger who recites to you the clear signs of God. That He might bring those who believe and do righteous deeds out of darkness into light} [At-Talaq: 10-11].
It is known that the Messenger - himself - was not sent down, but rather the Messenger was substituted from the remembrance; Because the Messenger brought the remembrance.

Since the royal messenger, the human messenger, and the revealed remembrance are related matters, the confirmation of one requires the confirmation of the others, and from faith In one belief in others, it follows that the Qur’an is true that Gabriel and Muhammad were true, and likewise it follows that Muhammad was true Gabriel and the Qur’an are true, and it follows that Gabriel is true that the Qur’an and Muhammad are true.

For this reason, God combined belief in the angels, the Scriptures, and the messengers, such as His saying: {The Messenger believed in what was revealed to him from his Lord, and so do the believers. Everyone believes in God and His angels and His books and His messengers} [Al-Baqarah: 285].

So the teaching, remembrance, and testimony of Muhammad is the teaching of the Holy Spirit and His spirit, and the news that the angel speaks through the tongue of man, or The genie speaks a lot on the human tongue, as in the hadith of Ibn Omar: “We used to talk about the word tranquility being spoken on the tongue of Omar,” and it is said: “He did not deliver “This is on your tongue, except for Satan.” And with this human being he speaks according to his ability and choice. He is not like the demon to whom the genie speaks. on his tongue while he knows what he is saying; That is why it is said: This is the saying of the human Messenger, and it is the saying of the Royal Messenger.

It is said: The Pharaklete, the Spirit of truth and the Holy Spirit, bears witness of me, and he teaches you, and he reminds you, and so on. For the Pharaklete includes He mentioned Gabriel and Muhammad together, and the saying of one of them is the saying of the other, and it is known in the language instead of inclusion; Such as his saying: {They ask you about the sacred month, fighting therein. Say, fighting therein} [Al-Baqarah: 217].
The month is not the same as fighting, but when it included fighting, one of them was replaced by the other, and His saying: {Allah has sent down to you a reminder - A Messenger} [At-Talaq: 10-11].

From this pattern, the messenger was replaced from the male because it included it, and this second included the first, and the human messenger was the royal messenger. He is connected to it inwardly, and the revelation becomes heavy for him when he sends it down.

And in the two Sahih books on the authority of Aisha, may God be pleased with her, “Al-Harith bin Hisham said: O Messenger of God, how does the revelation come to you? He said: Sometimes he comes to me like the ringing of a bell, and he is the hardest on me, so he separates from me, and I realized what he said, and sometimes he appears to me. The angel is a man, so he speaks to me and I understand what he says. Aisha said: “And I saw him descending on him on a very cold day, and then he was separated from him, and his forehead was dripping with sweat.”

Al-Fasam: jaw and separation are soft matters, as He said: {So whoever disbelieves in the tyrant and believes in God has certainly grasped the handle. The bond of trust cannot be broken, and God is All-Hearing, All-Knowing” [Al-Baqarah: 256].
And with the qāf: it is the kasra that occurs in solid matters.

He explained that when the revelation is sent down to the angel, he is connected to it and becomes confused by it, then after that he separates from it and disengages from it, and this Inclusion and separation are more eloquent than the other, so it is better to replace one of them with the other than the other. It is said: This Qur’an was conveyed by the Messenger, the Prophet, and Gabriel conveyed it on the authority of God, and there are many parallels to this in all the glad tidings of Christ. It is mentioned that the Father is in their language: God who sends the Pharoacles. And in some of them he said: “I will ask the Father to give you another Paraclete, who will abide with you forever.” And in some of them:
“And the Paraclete, the spirit of truth which my Father will send, he will teach you all things.” He explained that God is sending him, and that he is asking God to He sends him.

As for his saying in some words: “When I go, I will send him to you,” it means: I am sending him with the supplication of my father, and my request from him to He sends him, just as a student asks a ruler to send a messenger, or appoint a representative, or give someone, and say, “I sent this.” I took charge of this one, and I gave this one; That is, I was the reason for this. It should be known that when God decrees that a thing will come to be, He determines reasons for it to come into being, and one of those reasons is supplication. A group of His servants because of it. Thus, it would be a blessing in his response to the supplication of this, this, and that.

And Muhammad called upon the Hebron, peace be upon him, by him and said: {Our Lord, and send among them a messenger from among them who will recite to them Your revelations and teach them the Book and wisdom. And purify them. Indeed, You are the Mighty, the Wise.} [Al-Baqarah: 129].

Even though God decided to send him, and announced his name before that, as it was said to him: O Messenger of God, when were you a prophet? He said: “And Adam is between the soul and the body,” and he said: “In the sight of God, I am written as the Seal of the Prophets, and indeed Adam is one whose clay is muddy.”

This is just as God had granted him victory on the day of Badr, and among the reasons for that was his seeking God’s help, and also with what He had decreed of sending down One of the causes of rain is the supplication of His servants for it, and its counterparts are many, so it is not impossible that Christ asked his Lord after his ascension to send Muhammad, and this is one of the reasons for sending him, but Abraham asked in this world and God mentioned that, unlike the question of Christ, for he was After his ascension to heaven.

chapters.title: A chapter on independent Qur’anic proofs of his prophecy, may God bless him and grant him peace
paragraphs: [Chapter: Independent Quranic proofs of his prophecy, may God bless him and grant him peace]

The Qur’an - itself - has explained various types of signs of its prophecy and proofs of its message, with each type containing a number of verses. And the proofs, for example: his informing his people of the unseen, the past, which no human being can know unless he is a prophet, or is From those who learned it from a prophet, and his people know that he did not learn that from humans, nor from the People of the Book, nor from anyone else. There are two types of these: Among them: what the polytheists and the People of the Book used to ask him about; To see whether he is a prophet or not?

And his people used to send letters to the People of the Book, who were far away from them, such as those who were in Medina and other places from the People of the Book, asking Some of them ask him about it, so they send to them to ask him about that, and by that they test whether he is a prophet or not?

Among them: What God was telling him in the beginning, and made it knowledge and a sign for his prophecy, and proof of his message, in addition to what is mentioned in these Stories from consideration for other matters, so each of these two types was evidence and a lesson for his prophecy, in two ways, so it was evidence and a lesson for His prophecy was in terms of informing him of the unseen, which only a prophet knows, and it was a lesson for the conditions of believers and unbelievers. Which requires following the path of the believers who followed the like of it, and avoiding the path of the disbelievers who disobeyed the like of it, and the ruling on a thing is the ruling His counterpart.

If the condition of the one who was like him and the example of the one who followed him was happy, and the condition of the one who differed from him and the example of the one who followed him was wretched, then this is significant. It is a lesson that necessitates following it and forbidding going against it. This is also evidence of the prophecy of the prophets before him in two ways: On the one hand, he told the same thing as they told him, without any complicity between them and him, or any feelings. They did not take from him, and he did not take About them.

Each of them reported detailed news about God, on which it is usually impossible to agree except by collusion. If there is no collusion and sympathy, And it was impossible to agree on that without compromise. It is known that each of the informers is truthful. God Almighty said: {Indeed there were in Joseph and his brothers signs for those who ask.} [Joseph: 7].

He narrated his story in the Surah, until he said: {This is of the news of the unseen which We have revealed to you, and you were not with them when they gathered their affairs and were plotting - And most people will not, even if you strive to be believers - and you ask them of no reward for it. Indeed, it is only a reminder to the worlds - and there is as if there is a sign in the heavens. And the earth they pass over it, but they turn away from it - and most of them do not believe in Allah unless they are associated with Him.} [Yusuf: 102-106].
Until he said:

{Say: This is my way. I call to God with insight, I and those who follow me. And Glory be to God. I am not of the polytheists - nor have We been sent before you. Except for men to whom it was revealed from the people of the towns. Have they not traveled through the land and seen what was the end of those before them? And the abode of the Hereafter is better. For those who feared, will you not understand? - Even when the messengers despaired and thought that they had been lied to, Our help would come to them, and We would save whomever We willed, and he would not be rejected. How miserable we are on behalf of the criminal people - indeed in their stories there is a lesson for those of understanding. It was not a fabricated hadith, but the confirmation of what was before him. And an explanation of everything, a guidance and a mercy for a people who believe.} [Yusuf:
And God Almighty said: {And they ask you about Dhul-Qarnayn. Say, “I will recite to you a reminder of him” [Al-Kahf: 83].
And he said: {And they ask you about the spirit. Say, “The spirit is from the command of my Lord, and you have not been given of knowledge except a little.” [Al-Isra: 85].
And he said: {Or did you think that the Companions of the Cave and Ar-Raqim were a wonder among Our signs?} [Al-Kahf: 9].

And God Almighty said when he narrated the story of Noah from Surah Hud, which is the longest thing he narrated in the story of Noah: {These are of the tidings of the unseen which We have revealed to you as long as you Neither you nor your people know it before this, so be patient. Indeed, the outcome is for the righteous.} [Hud: 49].
So, Glory be to Him, He mentioned that this, which He had revealed to him of the news of the unseen, neither he nor his people knew before this.

So if his people did not know that, neither from the People of the Book, nor from anyone else, and he only lived with his people, and his people knew. That is from him, and they know that they did not know that, and they know - also - that he did not learn that, and that it was not He associates with others, and they do not know it. This has become a proof against his people, and against whomever the news of his people reaches him, and similar to what he told them about... The story of Adam, and the angels prostrating to him, and Satan beautifying him until he ate from the tree, and he and his wife went down.

And he told them about the story of Noah and his stay among them for a thousand years minus fifty years, and this is in the Torah found in the hands of the People of the Book: The amount of time he spent among his people before and after drowning.

He told them about the story of Hebron, and what happened to him with his people, and his being thrown into the fire, and the slaughter of his son, and the angels coming to him in the form of guests, and his good news about Isaac and Jacob, and the angels going to Lot, and what happened to Lot with his people, and God destroying the cities of his people Lot, and the story of Israel with his sons; Like the story of Joseph, and what happened to him in Egypt, and the story of Moses with Pharaoh, and God speaking to him time after time, and His signs like the staff and the hand. white, and lice, and frogs, and blood, and the parting of the sea, and the shading of the clouds over the children of Israel, and feeding them with manna and quails, and the bursting Twelve springs of water from the stone for their irrigation, and for their worship of the calf, and some of them killed one another when God turned to them in repentance, and the story of the cow. And he raised the mountain above them, and the story of David, and his killing of Goliath, and the story of those who went out

From their homes, and they were thousands. He feared death, so God said to them, “Die, then He brought them back to life.” And the story of the one whom God put to death for a hundred years, then resurrected him. And other than that is the condition of the Children of Israel.

Until he mentioned the story of Zechariah and his son Yahya, and Jesus the son of Mary, and the conditions of the Messiah and his signs, and his supplication for his people, and the signs With which he was sent, and the details of that, and he mentioned the story of the Companions of the Cave, and the story of Dhul-Qarnayn, and other stories of the prophets. And the righteous and the unbelievers, in detail, explained with the best explanation and most complete knowledge, with the knowledge of his people who knew his circumstances from his childhood until That he claimed prophethood:

He did not learn this from any human being. Rather, he had not met any human being who knew this, nor was there anyone in Mecca with them who knew. This is neither a Jew nor a Christian, nor anyone else.

So this was one of the greatest signs and proofs for his people that this was only known to him and God informed him of it, and like this unseen. No one knows it except a prophet, or someone who took it from a prophet. If he did not take it from a prophet, then it must be a prophet.

Then the rest of the people of the earth know that he did not learn that from humans, in ways: one of which is: that his people were hostile to him, who were from People were keen to slander his prophecy, despite their perfect knowledge - if they had known that he had learned that from humans - they would have criticized him for it and exposed it. For, despite their knowledge of his condition, it is impossible for them not to know that if it were, and despite their eagerness to slander him, it is impossible for them not to slander him. In it, and it is impossible that this does not appear.
Second: It has been reported on the authority of his people that they used to say: There was no one to teach him that.

Third: If he had learned these various stories from the People of the Book - despite his enmity towards them - they would have told this, And they show it, and if they had shown that, it would have been transmitted and known, for this is one of the incidents that provide inspiration and reasons for transmitting it.

Fourth: Where he was sent, the people were either polytheists or people of the Book, and there was no one who adhered to the religion to which he called, and the people knew of the frequent transmission. The polytheists - from the Quraysh and others - did not know these stories, and if it were assumed that they did know them, they would be the first to He invited them to his religion, but they rejected him and rejected him. If there had been someone among them who taught him, or knew that he had learned from others, he would have demonstrated that.

Fifth: If something like this happened, then it must be known - even by the elite of people - and among its companions who believed in it were those who knew that. This would have been widely known, even if they had advised each other to conceal it, just as it was widely known that the affairs of the inner states were concealed, and his inner circle would have known. He lied, and their knowledge of that contradicted their secret belief in him, as was known in such cases.

So how, when the most private of his companions and the most knowledgeable about his condition was the most loving and loyal to them? Unlike the condition of someone who conceals something other than what he appears, the elite of his companions do not honor him inwardly.

For the people knew that his people, who were extremely hostile to him and were seeking to discredit his prophecy in every way, knew Because they did not have anyone to teach him something like this, and that there was no one among his people or his country who knew this.

The people knew what his people taught him, that God had informed him of this, and this was one of His signs, signs, and proofs, and this is what clarifies God says in the Qur’an that it is one of His signs, and that when he told his people about this - despite their disbelief and extreme hostility towards him - he did not enable anyone One of them is to say to him: Rather, among us there was someone who knew that, and you knew that, and you learned it from us or from others. So their admission was that he did not know and they did not know,
Despite their extreme hostility toward him, it is a clear sign to all nations that it was not him, nor do they know it.

For this reason, when some of them were blatantly slandering him, they all knew that he was lying, and when they gathered and consulted about his matter, They know that this is an obvious lie about him, as some of them used to say: He is crazy, and some of them say: He is a priest, and some of them say: He is a magician, and some of them say that he learned it from humans, and some of them say that it is pipe dreams.

So God narrated their words, showing the apparent lie of whoever said that, and that it was the statement of a misguided and confused person. He was astonished by the condition of the Messenger, so he was confused, so he did not He knows what he is saying, as God Almighty said:

{Blessed is He who sent down the Criterion upon His servant, that he might be a warner to the worlds. He is a partner in the kingdom, and He created everything and determined it with due determination - and they took apart from Him gods who did not create anything, while they were created but did not possess. They will neither harm nor benefit for themselves, and they will have no power over death, life, or resurrection. Other people have come unjustly and falsely - and they say: He wrote down the legends of the ancients, and they will be dictated to him morning and evening - say: He who knows revealed it. The secret in the heavens and the earth is that He is Forgiving, Merciful} [Al-Furqan:

So he told about the one who said that, and they know that this is the most obvious lie, for these stories mentioned in the Qur’an were not In Mecca, who knows it, let alone dictates it, as He said: {And you had not recited any book before it, nor traced it with your right hand} [Al-Ankabut: 48] .
And he said: “Neither you nor your people knew it before this” [Hud: 49].
That is why He said: {It was sent down by Him who knows the secret in the heavens and the earth} [Al-Furqan: 6].

So he told that this is from the knowledge of the one who knows the secret, since humans did not know this except through the reports of the prophets, and not in Mecca. Who knows what the prophets have told us?

Then he mentioned what they suggested and said: {And they said: What is the matter with this Messenger who eats food and walks in the markets, unless an angel has been sent down to him and he will be with him? a warner - or treasure will be given to him, or he will have a garden from which he may eat. And the wrongdoers say, “You follow none other than a man bewitched” - see how they struck you. Examples have gone astray and are not able to find a way.} [Al-Furqan: 7-9].

He commanded us to look into the nature of the proverbs they used, as they likened him to someone, and the difference between him and him is clearly evident to the observer. That is why He said: {They have gone astray and are not able to find a way} [Al-Furqan: 9].
Since it is clear that this is a straying from the path of the truth, then the one who strays from the path of the truth cannot find a way to it.

And God Almighty said: {So when you recite the Qur’an, seek refuge in Allah from the accursed Satan. Indeed, he has no authority over those who believe and over their Lord. They put their trust - His authority is only over those who trust Him and those who associate with Him - And when We change a verse for another verse, and God knows best what He is sending down. They said, “You are merely an inventor.” Nay, most of them do not know. Say, “It was sent down by the Holy Spirit from your Lord in truth to confirm those who believe, and as a guidance and good tidings.” For the Muslims - And we know that they say that only human beings teach it. The language of those to whom they atheate is foreign, and this is a clear Arabic language.} [An-Nahl:
So he told about what some of them had fabricated, such as: “This Qur’an is only taught to humans.”

In Mecca, there was a foreign master of some Quraysh. It was said that he was a master of Banu al-Hadrami, and the Prophet did not do well to speak the language of the non-Arabs. It is not appropriate for him to speak these Arabic words. When they said: Indeed, he fabricated this Qur’an, and that a human being taught it to him, God Almighty said: {The tongue of those who are atheists} [An-Nahl: 103].
That is, they add this teaching to it, and attribute it to him, and he expressed it with the word atheism; Because of the inclination in it, he said:

The tongue of this person, whom they said was teaching him the Qur’an, is a foreign tongue, and they could not extend this teaching to an Arab man. Rather, to this foreigner; Because he would sometimes sit with the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, and that foreigner could not speak these Arabic words. He is a foreigner, and Muhammad is not known for speaking the foreign language, but the goal of that foreigner, like Abd Bani al-Hadrami, is to know a little of the speech of the Arabs that He usually needs it, such as the words he needs most of the time; He is like bread and water and heaven and earth, and he does not know how to recite a single surah of the Qur’an.

So, Glory be to Him, made it clear that their lies in what they had fabricated, and none of them said anything that could be suspected of having learned news of the unseen. From the scholars of the People of the Book and the like, but they only said what is clearly false to everyone, and it was not reported from any of them that he said A statement whose falsehood is hidden, but rather its lie is not apparent to everyone.

So it became clear that they could not say: He learned the news of the unseen from anyone. And this story: the story of Noah - especially his story in Surah Hud, as mentioned above - is known only to a prophet, or someone who received it from a prophet. If it is known that he did not receive it from anyone, it is known that he is a prophet. For this reason, the Almighty said at the end of it: {These are of the news of the unseen. We reveal them to you. You nor your people knew them before this, so be patient. Indeed, the final outcome is for the righteous.} [Hud: 49].
The saying in all the stories is the same as the saying in them.
And as He said - in Surah Yusuf -: {This is of the news of the unseen which We have revealed to you, and you were not with them when they gathered their affair and were plotting} [Yusuf: 102].

And he said - in Surah Al Imran, when he mentioned the story of Zechariah and Maryam -: {This is of the tidings of the unseen which We have revealed to you, and you were not with them when they met Their pens - which of them will be responsible for Mary - and you were not with them when they disputed} [Al Imran: 44].

And he said: - In the story of Moses -: {And you were not beside the west when We conveyed to Moses the matter, and you were not of the witnesses - but We created generations. So their lives became long for them, and you were not a resident among the people of Madin reciting to them Our verses, but we were messengers - and you were not by the mountain when we called. But a mercy from your Lord} [Al-Qasas: 44-46] the verse.

A person only knows something like this through witnessing or news, so he pointed out by saying: (And you were not with them) that you only knew that. By informing us, suggesting to you, and informing you of that, since it was known to everyone who knew him, that he had not heard that from any human being. And neither he nor his people knew that.

And God Almighty said: {Say, “If God had willed, I would not have recited it to you nor would I have made it known to you. I have remained among you for a lifetime before it. Will you not understand?” [Yunus: 16] .

He thus made clear that his reciting this book to them, and making them administer it; That is, informing them of it, is by God’s will and power, not of His own accord, as God Almighty said: {And when Our verses are recited to them as clear signs Those who do not hope for the meeting with Us will say: Bring a Qur’an other than this or change it. Say: It is not for me to change it of my own accord. I follow only what is revealed. Indeed, I fear, if I disobey my Lord, the punishment of a great day - Say, “If God had willed, I would not have recited it to you nor would I have made it known to you” [Yunus: 15-16].

So it is clear that he stayed among them for a lifetime before him, and he does not recite any of that, nor does he teach it, nor inform them of it, so the matter is not from On his part, but on the part of God, who, if He had willed, would not have recited it to them nor told them to do it, and reciting it to them and telling them to do it is one of Informing about the unseen that only a prophet knows, and explaining that this is from the sending that God loves and is pleased with, not from the universal that He appreciated him, but he did not love him or accept him. Like sending devils, and for this reason they were offering him to become their king, and to give him gifts so that he would be one of the richest of them, and to give him something in marriage. He wanted from their wives, and he says:
“If you had placed the sun in my right hand and the moon in my left so that I could give up this matter, I would not be able to give it up.” And these three are

What souls seek from this world is (power, money, and women), so he turns away from accepting the world, which is the goal of the seeker’s aspirations, and explains Because he is unable to abandon what he has been commanded to do regarding conveying the message.

And God Almighty said: {And if they were about to tempt you away from what We have revealed to you, so that you might invent against Us something other than it, then they would certainly have taken you as a friend - and had it not been We have strengthened you. You were almost relying on them for a little thing - then We would have made you taste twice the life and double the death, and then you would not find you a helper over us - and if They almost provoked you from the land to expel you from it, but then they would not stay behind you except a little - the tradition of those whom We had sent before you of Our messengers. And you will not find any change in our Sunnah.} [Al-Isra: 73-77].

God Almighty made it clear that they almost prevented it in every way, for man only completes his work by his will and ability. With firm management and complete ability, what is destined must be present, and if one of them is not possible, they must abstain, then they ask to change his will. Let him rely on them and change what was revealed to him, so God protected him and made him firm.

Then they sought to incapacitate him by provoking him and expelling him, so that he would be unable to convey the message of his Lord, and if that were the case, God would have healed them. With punishment, just like the messengers before him, for if God wanted to destroy a nation, He would take out its prophet from it and then destroy it, not He will destroy it while he is among it, as God Almighty said: {And God would not chastise them while you were among them, and God would not chastise them while they were They ask forgiveness} [Al-Anfal: 33].
And this is after he said: {And when they said, “O God, if this is the truth from You, then rain down upon us stones from the sky, or give us With a painful punishment} [Al-Anfal: 32].
God Almighty said: {And God would not punish them while you were among them, and God would not punish them while they were seeking forgiveness} [Al-Anfal: 33].
When he left among them in the migration, God brought upon them a painful punishment on the day of Badr and other days, for He said: {And if they were about to tempt you} [Al-Isra: 73]. .
An indication of their effort to corrupt his will.
And His saying: {And if they were about to expel you from the land} [Al-Isra: 76].
An indication of their effort to make it impossible.
And God Almighty said: “And you had not recited any book before it, nor did you write it with your right hand. Then the untruthful would doubt.” [Al-Ankabut: 48].

Glory be to Him has made clear of His condition what is known to the common people and the special ones, and it is known to all of His people who witnessed it, and it is frequent among those who were absent. About him, and news about him reached him from all the people: that he was illiterate and did not read a book, nor memorize any book, whether revealed or otherwise, He does not read anything written, neither a revealed book nor anything else, nor does he write a book with his right hand, nor does he abrogate anything from people’s revealed books or anything else.

It is known that whoever learns from someone else either learns it by learning and memorizing it, or takes it from his book, even though he did not read anything. He memorized books from his heart, but he does not read written books. He who takes from someone else’s book either reads it or copies it, and he did not He reads and does not copy.
